title: Cloud vs. on-premise large language models for urgent patient-portal message screening: a comparative evaluation
zh_title: 云端与本地大模型用于紧急患者门户消息筛查的比较评估
summary: 以医生标准比较六种LLM在三组患者门户消息中识别紧急消息的表现，含云端与可本地部署的开放权重模型。
key_points: 三组共约1,300条消息，含院外公开平台
初级保健中GPT-5无漏诊紧急消息
四个模型敏感度≥0.97，含一款可本地部署
reason: 多队列含院外数据，回顾性评估，贴近落地，属值得一看档
abstract: Patient portal messaging carries a substantial share of outpatient communication, and rising message volume has slowed clinical response to urgent concerns embedded in routine traffic. Whether large language models (LLMs) can triage these messages, and whether locally hosted open-weight models can match cloud-hosted ones, remains unclear. We evaluated six LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, Llama 4 Scout, GPT-OSS 20B, Gemma 3 27B) against a physician reference standard in three cohorts: 500 primary care messages enriched for urgent cases, 503 epilepsy clinic messages from the same health system, and 300 patient-authored messages from public platforms outside it. Under Majority adjudication in primary care, GPT-5 missed no urgent message, and four of six models, including one deployable on-premises, reached sensitivity 0.97 or higher and negative predictive value 0.98 or higher. Rank ordering held across cohorts. Both cloud-hosted and on-premise LLMs can rule out urgent messages with high sensitivity, though specificity remained limited.
zh_abstract: 患者门户消息承载了相当大比例的门诊沟通，而不断增加的消息量延缓了对夹杂在常规消息中的紧急问题的临床响应。大语言模型（LLM）能否对这些消息进行分诊，以及本地部署的开放权重模型能否与云端部署的模型相媲美，目前仍不明确。我们以医师参考标准，在三个队列中评估了六个LLM（GPT-4o、GPT-5、GPT-5 Mini、Llama 4 Scout、GPT-OSS 20B、Gemma 3 27B）：500条富集紧急病例的基层医疗消息、来自同一卫生系统的503条癫痫门诊消息，以及来自该系统之外公共平台的300条患者撰写的消息。在基层医疗中采用多数裁定时，GPT-5没有漏掉任何紧急消息，六个模型中有四个（包括一个可本地部署的模型）的敏感度达到0.97或更高，阴性预测值达到0.98或更高。各队列间的排序保持一致。云端部署和本地部署的LLM均能以高敏感度排除紧急消息，但特异度仍然有限。

title: Tele-Cranio: a CT-free AI solution for remote diagnosis and planning of craniomaxillofacial deformities
zh_title: Tele-Cranio：无需CT的颅颌面畸形远程诊断与规划AI
summary: Tele-Cranio利用手机2D面部照片重建3D面部形态、估计骨骼形态，并按医生骨骼方案模拟术后面貌，基于539例配对多模态样本开发。

reason: 新颖的无CT方法，样本数百例，摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is central to craniomaxillofacial (CMF) deformity care, yet dependence on in-hospital imaging constrains remote preoperative assessment and outcome visualization, and repeated imaging can increase radiation and access burdens, particularly for children. We developed Tele-Cranio, a telemedicine-oriented artificial intelligence framework that uses mobile-acquired 2D facial photographs to reconstruct 3D facial morphology, estimate corresponding skeletal morphology and support postoperative facial simulation conditioned on surgeon-defined skeletal plans. Tele-Cranio was developed using 539 paired multimodal samples comprising 2D facial photographs, 3D facial scans and CT-derived skeletal models from individuals aged 3–60 years, including 334 patients with CMF deformities across malocclusion, cleft lip with/without palate, hemifacial microsomia and rare anomalies. Its core model, the Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity, learns a shared anatomical representation linking facial soft tissue and skeletal structures across normal and pathological morphology. For remote assessment, Tele-Cranio converts facial photographs into 3D facial surfaces and then infers 3D patient-specific skeletal geometry. For simulation, it generates individualized 3D postoperative facial previews after clinicians complete skeletal planning using standard clinical tools. Validated across heterogeneous CMF subgroups, Tele-Cranio provides an interpretable CT-free layer for remote triage, pre-CT consultation, radiation-free follow-up and surgeon–patient communication, while complementing rather than replacing CT-based definitive diagnosis and operative planning.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）在颅颌面（CMF）畸形诊疗中处于核心地位，但对院内影像检查的依赖限制了远程术前评估和结局可视化，且重复成像会增加辐射和就医可及性负担，儿童尤其如此。我们开发了 Tele-Cranio，这是一种面向远程医疗的人工智能框架，利用手机采集的二维面部照片重建三维面部形态，估计相应的骨骼形态，并在外科医生设定骨骼方案的条件下支持术后面部模拟。Tele-Cranio 使用 539 个配对的多模态样本开发，这些样本包括二维面部照片、三维面部扫描和源自 CT 的骨骼模型，受试者年龄为 3–60 岁，其中包括 334 例 CMF 畸形患者，涵盖错颌畸形、唇裂伴/不伴腭裂、半侧颜面短小症及罕见畸形。其核心模型 Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity 可学习一种共享的解剖学表征，将正常和病理形态下的面部软组织与骨骼结构联系起来。在远程评估方面，Tele-Cranio 先将面部照片转换为三维面部表面，再推断出患者特异性的三维骨骼几何结构。在模拟方面，临床医生使用标准临床工具完成骨骼规划后，它可生成个体化的三维术后面部预览。经过在异质性 CMF 亚组中的验证，Tele-Cranio 为远程分诊、CT 前会诊、无辐射随访以及医患沟通提供了一个可解释的免 CT 层，对基于 CT 的最终诊断和手术规划起补充而非替代作用。

title: Enabling lab autonomy with reward functions and executable workflows
zh_title: 以奖励函数和可执行工作流实现实验室自主化
summary: 观点文章认为实验室自主化不只是文本问题，主张自驱动实验室采用信息效率目标，并将假设编译为可在真实仪器上执行的决策。
key_points: 自主科学家不应仅依赖语言优先的规划
提出信息效率目标：单位实验成本的决策相关信息最大化
将假设编译为可在仪器上执行的实验流程
reason: 观点类上限6分；涉及AI科学发现但与医疗关系较间接
abstract: Autonomous scientists enabled by large language models and agentic reasoning have become a compelling narrative for accelerating research. Here we pose that labaoratory autonomy is not primarily a text problem, as experiments have to be run in the world of instrument-addressable actions and constraints, and planned based on costs, latencies and rewards. We argue for a bottom-up foundation for self-driving laboratories that complements language-first planning by introducing frameworks that translate hypotheses into decisions executable on real tools. We propose three operational principles. First, self-driving laboratories should adopt an information-efficiency objective that maximizes decision-relevant information per unit experimental cost. This requires combining comprehensive data acquisition with minimal, decisive experimental design. Second, hypotheses should be compiled into experimental footprints defined by accessible actions, constraints, observables and decision rules. Third, reward design should be treated as a central bottleneck in closed-loop experimentation, especially when high-dimensional measurements must be mapped to utility or extended to sequential decision-making. We frame self-driving laboratories as long-horizon, out-of-distribution discovery systems where accelerating the full experiment–model–decision loop and emphasizing physical and chemical knowledge discovery over short-term correlations is necessary to translate lab-scale optimization into durable technological and manufacturing impact. Kalinin et al. argue that for self-driving laboratories to achieve autonomy in the physical world, large language model hypothesis generation needs to be complemented by bottom-up optimization translating hypotheses into executable workflows.
zh_abstract: 由大语言模型和智能体推理驱动的自主科学家，已成为加速科研的一种引人注目的叙事。在此我们提出，实验室自主性主要并非文本问题，因为实验必须在仪器可寻址的动作和约束所构成的世界中运行，并基于成本、延迟和回报进行规划。我们主张为自驱动实验室建立自下而上的基础，通过引入将假设转化为可在真实工具上执行的决策的框架，对以语言为先的规划加以补充。我们提出三项操作原则。第一，自驱动实验室应采用信息效率目标，即最大化单位实验成本所获得的与决策相关的信息。这需要将全面的数据采集与极简而具决定性的实验设计相结合。第二，假设应被编译为由可用动作、约束、可观测量和决策规则所定义的实验足迹。第三，回报设计应被视为闭环实验中的核心瓶颈，尤其是当高维测量结果必须映射为效用，或需扩展到序贯决策时。我们将自驱动实验室定义为长周期、分布外的发现系统，其中，加快完整的实验–模型–决策循环，并强调物理和化学知识的发现而非短期相关性，对于将实验室尺度的优化转化为持久的技术和制造影响是必要的。Kalinin 等人认为，自驱动实验室要在物理世界中实现自主性，大语言模型的假设生成需要由将假设转化为可执行工作流的自下而上的优化加以补充。

title: Virtual atrial fibrillation dynamics reflect clinical outcomes after catheter ablation
zh_title: 虚拟房颤动力学反映导管消融后临床结局
summary: 基于323例患者高密度电解剖图构建左房数字孪生，模拟房颤，复极特征聚类可分层消融后房性心律失常复发风险。
key_points: 323例患者重建左房数字孪生
聚类得到四种复极模式，风险分层
虚拟房颤非持续性独立预测较低复发
reason: 关联临床结局，样本中等，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: Chamber-wide assessment of restitution dynamics is not feasible in vivo during atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. We reconstructed left-atrial digital twins from high-density (HD) bipolar electroanatomical maps in 323 patients, computed node-level restitution steepness (maximal restitution slope [Smax]; >0.4 million nodes), and induced virtual AF with standardized ramp pacing to classify sustainability (sustained ≥16 s vs non-sustained <16 s), excluding 32 cases with extensive low-voltage substrate and depressed mean Smax. We found that clustering of HD restitution profiles identifies four restitution patterns that stratify clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrence, with the Overall-Low pattern (aHR, 0.37) and the Average-Homogeneous pattern (aHR, 0.59) each showing lower risk than the Overall-High pattern. Furthermore, non-sustained virtual AF independently predicted lower recurrence (aHR: 0.27). Adding restitution pattern and sustainability to clinical covariates improved discrimination (ΔHarrell’s C-index: 0.050), and the combined digital-twin model remained incremental after adjustment for low-voltage area burden, supporting digital-twin outputs as complementary functional descriptors for risk stratification after pulmonary vein isolation.
zh_abstract: 在心房颤动（AF）消融过程中，无法在体对整个心腔的复极恢复（restitution）动力学进行评估。我们基于323例患者的高密度（HD）双极电解剖标测重建了左心房数字孪生体，计算了节点水平的复极恢复陡度（最大复极恢复斜率 [Smax]；>40万个节点），并采用标准化递增起搏（ramp pacing）诱发虚拟AF，以对其持续性进行分类（持续≥16 s 为持续性，<16 s 为非持续性），同时排除了32例存在广泛低电压基质且平均Smax降低的病例。我们发现，对HD复极恢复特征进行聚类可识别出四种复极恢复模式，这些模式可对临床房性心律失常复发进行分层：与“整体偏高”（Overall-High）模式相比，“整体偏低”（Overall-Low）模式（aHR，0.37）和“平均均匀”（Average-Homogeneous）模式（aHR，0.59）的风险均更低。此外，非持续性虚拟AF独立预测更低的复发风险（aHR：0.27）。在临床协变量基础上加入复极恢复模式和持续性后，区分度得到改善（Harrell C 指数增加 ΔC-index：0.050），并且在校正低电压区域负荷后，联合数字孪生模型仍具有增量价值，支持数字孪生输出可作为肺静脉隔离术后风险分层的补充性功能描述指标。

title: Epidemiology-informed graph neural networks for predicting and interpreting transmissible hospital-acquired infections
zh_title: 流行病学启发的图神经网络预测医院获得性感染传播
summary: 同行评审研究提出EIGNN，将机制性流行病学模型融入GNN，预测动态医院接触网络中患者层面状态转移并估计传播参数。
key_points: 结合动态接触网络与机制流行病学模型
预测多时间范围的患者状态转移
兼顾可解释性并估计关键流行病学参数
reason: 同行评审新方法，摘要未显示外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Transmissible hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) arise from complex, time-varying interactions among patients, healthcare workers, and clinical environments. Although data-driven approaches like graph neural networks (GNNs) effectively model these contacts, they often function as black boxes that overlook established epidemiological principles, limiting interpretability and clinical trust. Inspired by physics-informed neural networks, we propose an epidemiology-informed GNN (EIGNN) framework for patient-level state transitions prediction in dynamic hospital settings, integrating mechanistic epidemiological models into GNNs in a principled manner. Patient-level risk factors learned from dynamic contact networks are jointly leveraged to infer latent epidemiological states, predict state transitions across multiple horizons, and estimate key epidemiological parameters, including transmission and recovery rates. We evaluate the approach on a real-world hospital-onset COVID-19 cohort and two public datasets simulating viral and bacterial HAIs. Across multiple architectures and horizons, EIGNNs achieves AUC-ROC up to 98.46% while providing interpretable, mechanistically consistent insights, offering a transparent tool for infection prevention and control.
zh_abstract: 可传播的医院获得性感染（HAI）源于患者、医护人员和临床环境之间复杂且随时间变化的相互作用。尽管图神经网络（GNN）等数据驱动方法能有效建模这些接触，但它们往往作为黑箱运行，忽视已确立的流行病学原理，从而限制了可解释性和临床信任。受物理信息神经网络启发，我们提出一种流行病学信息图神经网络（EIGNN）框架，用于动态医院环境中患者层面状态转移的预测，以有原则的方式将机制性流行病学模型整合进 GNN。从动态接触网络中学习到的患者层面风险因素被联合用于推断潜在流行病学状态、预测多个时间跨度上的状态转移，并估计关键流行病学参数，包括传播率和恢复率。我们在一个真实世界的医院内发病 COVID-19 队列以及两个模拟病毒性和细菌性 HAI 的公开数据集上评估该方法。在多种架构和时间跨度下，EIGNN 的 AUC-ROC 最高达 98.46%，同时提供可解释且机制一致的见解，为感染预防与控制提供了一个透明的工具。

title: Shape-informed cardiac mechanics surrogates in data-scarce regimes via geometric encoding and generative augmentation
zh_title: 数据稀缺下的形状感知心脏力学代理模型
summary: 提出两步框架，先学习左心室几何潜在表示并生成合成几何增强数据，再用神经场代理模型预测心室位移。
key_points: 形状模型学习左心室紧凑潜在表示
合成几何用于数据增强
神经场模型以几何编码为条件预测位移
reason: 方法新颖的同行评审研究，但摘要未显示外部验证或临床结局
abstract: High-fidelity computational models of cardiac mechanics provide mechanistic insight into the heart function but are computationally prohibitive for routine clinical use. Surrogate models can accelerate simulations, but generalization across diverse anatomies is challenging, particularly in data-scarce settings. We propose a two-step framework that decouples geometric representation from learning the physics response, to enable shape-informed surrogate modeling under data-scarce conditions. First, a shape model learns a compact latent representation of left ventricular geometries. The learned latent space effectively encodes anatomies and enables synthetic geometries generation for data augmentation. Second, a neural field-based surrogate model, conditioned on this geometric encoding, is trained to predict ventricular displacement under external loading. The proposed architecture performs positional encoding by using universal ventricular coordinates, which improves generalization across diverse anatomies. Geometric variability is encoded using two alternative strategies, which are systematically compared: a PCA-based approach suitable for working with point cloud representations of geometries, and a DeepSDF-based implicit neural representation learned directly from point clouds. Overall, our results, obtained on idealized and patient-specific datasets, show that the proposed approaches allow for accurate predictions and generalization to unseen geometries, and robustness to noisy or sparsely sampled inputs.

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Cleaning of Report-Derived Labels in a Large-Scale Chest CT Dataset.

abstract: [Journal of medical systems] To evaluate whether large language model (LLM)-assisted label cleaning can identify label-report discordance in CT-RATE, a large-scale public chest CT dataset. After report-level deduplication, 24,446 unique radiology reports from 20,209 unique patients were identified. Twelve reports were excluded from the primary GPT-5.4 analysis because of persistent content-safety filtering or unparsable output, leaving 24,434 reports and 439,812 label instances across 18 abnormality categories. GPT-5.4-derived binary labels were generated from report text using structured outputs and compared with the original CT-RATE labels. Discordant instances were adjudicated by radiologists. In addition, 100 randomly sampled reports were manually annotated as a development set to compare the original CT-RATE labels, individual LLM-derived labels, and three-LLM majority-vote labels against radiologist-annotated reference labels. These label sources were then evaluated against a prespecified, stratified confirmatory set of 250 reports independently annotated by two blinded radiologists, and run-to-run consistency was assessed by repeated runs. Overall agreement between GPT-5.4-derived and CT-RATE labels was 96.4%, with a Cohen's κ of 0.884. Lymphadenopathy showed the lowest agreement and κ. In the confirmatory set (pre-consensus inter-reader κ = 0.936), the majority vote achieved an unweighted label-macro-averaged F1 score of 95.6% and κ of 0.940, compared with 90.8% and 0.879 for the original labels (paired F1 difference, + 4.8 points; 95% CI, 3.6-6.2), and each individual LLM also outperformed the original labels. The instance-level flip rate across three repeated runs was 1.02% for the majority vote. LLM-assisted label cleaning identified substantial label-report discordance in CT-RATE, particularly for lymphadenopathy, and may provide a scalable approach to quality improvement of public imaging datasets. The refined report-aligned labels and associated code will be made publicly available upon acceptance. Because all labels were derived from report text, they reflect report alignment rather than image-level truth.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical systems] 本研究旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）辅助的标签清洗能否识别大规模公开胸部 CT 数据集 CT-RATE 中标签与报告之间的不一致。经报告层面去重后，共识别出来自 20,209 名独立患者的 24,446 份唯一放射学报告。由于持续的内容安全过滤或输出无法解析，12 份报告被排除在主要的 GPT-5.4 分析之外，剩余 24,434 份报告，涉及 18 个异常类别共 439,812 个标签实例。利用结构化输出，基于报告文本生成 GPT-5.4 衍生的二分类标签，并与 CT-RATE 原始标签比较。不一致的实例由放射科医师裁定。此外，随机抽取 100 份报告进行人工标注作为开发集，用于将 CT-RATE 原始标签、单个 LLM 衍生标签以及三个 LLM 的多数投票标签与放射科医师标注的参考标签进行比较。随后，这些标签来源在一个预先设定的、分层的 250 份报告验证集上进行评估，该验证集由两名盲法放射科医师独立标注，并通过重复运行评估运行间一致性。GPT-5.4 衍生标签与 CT-RATE 标签之间的总体一致率为 96.4%，Cohen's κ 为 0.884。淋巴结肿大的一致性和 κ 最低。在验证集中（共识前读片者间 κ = 0.936），多数投票取得的未加权标签宏平均 F1 分数为 95.6%，κ 为 0.940，而原始标签分别为 90.8% 和 0.879（配对 F1 差值 +4.8 个百分点；95% CI，3.6–6.2），且每个单独的 LLM 也优于原始标签。三次重复运行中，多数投票的实例级翻转率为 1.02%。LLM 辅助的标签清洗识别出 CT-RATE 中大量的标签与报告不一致，尤其是淋巴结肿大，可能为公开影像数据集的质量改进提供一种可扩展的方法。经改进的与报告一致的标签及相关代码将在论文被接受后公开发布。由于所有标签均源自报告文本，它们反映的是与报告的一致性，而非影像层面的真实情况。

abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming drug design by enabling the systematic discovery of therapeutic targets and the prediction of drug response from complex biomedical data. In papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC), lymph node metastasis remains a key determinant of poor outcome, yet targetable drivers and predictive models for metastasis are lacking. Here, we integrate single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and machine learning to identify SPP1⁺ tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) as a functionally validated driver of lymph node metastasis in PTC. Using single-cell and spatial analyses, we show that SPP1⁺ TAMs engage TM4SF1⁺ malignant epithelial cells via the SPP1–CD44 axis within a hypoxic niche, driving tumor stemness, invasion, and metastatic progression. SPP1⁺ TAMs exhibit a hypoxic, M2-polarized phenotype and their abundance correlates with worse overall and progression‑free survival in metastatic PTC patients. We further develop an integrative machine-learning model based on SPP1⁺ TAM‑derived molecular features that predicts lymph node status with high accuracy. Preclinically, pharmacological targeting of SPP1 attenuates tumor cell migration, invasion, and lung metastasis, supporting its candidacy as a therapeutic target. Collectively, this study demonstrates how AI‑driven multi‑omics analysis can jointly identify a functionally validated target and generate a clinically deployable predictive model, illustrating a framework for bridging computational discovery with translational oncology.

abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] 1.Artificial intelligence models for echocardiography interpret studies without identifying the structures that support their outputs. We show that this spatial grounding does not emerge from the pretraining of current vision-language models. General-purpose and medical vision-language models and an open-vocabulary detector recalled 3% or fewer of cardiac structures and scored below a box that never sees the image. EchoLens, a detector trained on 5,912 expert-annotated structures and 4,219 Doppler signals from 136 patients, recalled 87% and localized structures as reliably as a blinded expert reader (box centre within the reference in 95.7% and 95.3% of cases). It covers 21 structures across 11 transthoracic views and 11 spectral Doppler signal types. In external data, two physicians judged 81- 92% of its detections correct across all 11 views, and it identified the Doppler signal type in 83% of frames. EchoLens provides the spatial layer that grounded echocardiographic interpretation requires.

abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Recent advances in protein language models, geometric deep learning, and structure prediction frameworks have the potential to accelerate computational drug discovery. However, it remains unclear how well these methods generalize beyond their training sets. Mutation-dependent drug responses present a challenge to these methods because there are often large effects from relatively small perturbations. Here, we systematically benchmark diverse mutational effect and drug-target affinity prediction models using deep mutational scanning datasets spanning 11 inhibitor conditions for the MET kinase domain. Across both mutational effect prediction and drug-target affinity tasks, current AI models produce largely ligand-invariant predictions despite experimentally distinct inhibitor-dependent fitness landscapes. Ligand-aware geometric models, including LigandMPNN and LASErMPNN, partially recover experimentally validated resistance-associated hotspots, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling protein-ligand interactions and local structural flexibility. In contrast, deep learning affinity prediction models underestimate mutation-induced changes in binding affinity. This deficiency likely reflects mutation-invariant structural priors derived from co-folded structure prediction frameworks and the absence of mutation-conditioned supervision in current affinity datasets. Finally, we further extended our analysis to several kinase-inhibitor deep mutational scanning datasets and confirm the overall trends. Our findings suggest that a primary limitation in improving performance on this task lies in the scarcity of mutation-conditioned protein-ligand training data rather than model architecture alone.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] 蛋白质语言模型、几何深度学习和结构预测框架的最新进展有望加速计算药物发现。然而，这些方法在训练集之外的泛化能力究竟如何仍不清楚。依赖突变的药物反应对这些方法构成挑战，因为相对较小的扰动往往会带来巨大的效应。在此，我们利用涵盖 MET 激酶结构域 11 种抑制剂条件的深度突变扫描数据集，系统地对多种突变效应预测模型和药物-靶标亲和力预测模型进行了基准测试。在突变效应预测和药物-靶标亲和力两类任务中，尽管实验显示不同抑制剂对应的适应度景观明显不同，当前的 AI 模型给出的预测在很大程度上与配体无关。包括 LigandMPNN 和 LASErMPNN 在内的配体感知几何模型，部分重现了经实验验证的耐药相关热点，凸显了显式建模蛋白-配体相互作用和局部结构灵活性的重要性。相比之下，深度学习亲和力预测模型低估了突变引起的结合亲和力变化。这一缺陷可能反映了源自共折叠结构预测框架的、与突变无关的结构先验，以及当前亲和力数据集中缺乏以突变为条件的监督。最后，我们将分析进一步扩展到若干激酶-抑制剂深度突变扫描数据集，并证实了总体趋势。我们的研究结果表明，提升该任务性能的主要限制在于缺乏以突变为条件的蛋白-配体训练数据，而不仅仅是模型架构。

abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] High-performance promoters are essential tools for precisely regulating gene expression, yet their rational design within the vast combinatorial sequence space remains a major challenge. Here, we present a hybrid framework that integrates a large language model (LLM) with a diffusion model to enable data-driven and interpretable promoter design. The fine-tuned LLM predicts promoter strength with high accuracy and, through systematic sequence mutations, identifies biologically essential core regions. A diffusion model is then conditioned on these core regions to reconstruct non-core regions and generate complete promoter sequences. We experimentally validated this approach in Escherichia coli by high-throughput barcoded promoter activity sequencing: 7.78% of the designed promoters outperformed the benchmark promoter BBa_J23119, with the best variants reaching approximately 2.5-fold the expression level of BBa_J23119. By explicitly coupling interpretability with generative design, this strategy provides a practical framework for promoter design in E. coli and may be adaptable to other regulatory sequence engineering tasks.
zh_abstract: [ACS 合成生物学] 高性能启动子是精确调控基因表达的重要工具，但在庞大的组合序列空间中对其进行理性设计仍是一大挑战。在此，我们提出一种将大语言模型（LLM）与扩散模型相结合的混合框架，以实现数据驱动且可解释的启动子设计。经微调的 LLM 能高精度预测启动子强度，并通过系统性序列突变识别出生物学上必需的核心区域。随后，以这些核心区域为条件，扩散模型重建非核心区域并生成完整的启动子序列。我们在大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）中通过高通量条形码启动子活性测序对该方法进行了实验验证：7.78% 的设计启动子优于基准启动子 BBa_J23119，最佳变体的表达水平约为 BBa_J23119 的 2.5 倍。通过将可解释性与生成式设计明确结合，该策略为大肠杆菌中的启动子设计提供了一个实用框架，并可能适用于其他调控序列工程任务。

abstract: Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Drug-target interaction (DTI) models can rank vast numbers of drug-target pairs, but limited experimental capacity restricts testing to a small number of candidates. We compared the bidirectional recommendations of 13 released systems across 711 molecular structures of FDA-approved drugs and 614 human proteins. For the same target or drug, pairs of models produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, respectively. Even where recommendations overlapped, agreement between some systems largely reflected recurring preferences for the same candidates. Published inhibition measurements for 79 molecules and 65 kinases revealed that some systems enriched active candidates, yet their hit yields changed little when recommendations were matched to different drugs or targets, whereas other systems lost substantially more hits. Some of the former systems also rarely ranked both molecules and kinases correctly when two drugs favoured different kinases. We further retrained the same architecture on the same data, with the training objective fixed and random seeds varied. Despite similar test performance, mean pairwise Top-10 overlap on a separate screening catalogue was about two candidates. Our study moves DTI model evaluation beyond benchmark performance to assess whether model predictions can guide meaningful experimental decisions in drug discovery and target identification.
zh_abstract: 确定已知靶点的活性分子以及现有药物的潜在靶点，是药物发现和药物重定位的核心。药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）模型可对海量药物-靶点对进行排序，但有限的实验能力使检测只能局限于少数候选对象。我们比较了13个已发布系统，针对711个FDA批准药物的分子结构和614个人类蛋白所给出的双向推荐。对于同一靶点或药物，模型两两之间产生的Top-10分子列表和蛋白列表完全不相交的比例分别为77.8%和70.1%。即便推荐结果存在重叠，部分系统之间的一致性也主要反映了对相同候选对象的反复偏好。对79个分子和65个激酶已发表的抑制测定数据显示，部分系统能够富集活性候选物，但当推荐结果与不同的药物或靶点相匹配时，其命中产出变化很小，而其他系统则损失了明显更多的命中。前一类系统中的一些系统，在两种药物偏好不同激酶时，也很少能同时正确地对分子和激酶进行排序。我们还在相同数据上重新训练了相同的架构，固定训练目标并改变随机种子。尽管测试性能相近，但在另一个筛选库上，平均两两Top-10重叠仅约为两个候选物。我们的研究使DTI模型评价超越基准性能，转而评估模型预测能否为药物发现和靶点识别中有意义的实验决策提供指导。

abstract: Transformer-based foundation models have shown strong potential for modeling longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs), yet existing models focus primarily on risk prediction rather than treatment effect estimation, which limits evidence generation. Here, we introduce the ITE-Transformer, a transformer-based framework that combines self-supervised representation learning from longitudinal patient trajectories with doubly robust causal machine learning for predicting individualized treatment effects (ITEs). As a result, our ITE-Transformer allows to study counterfactual questions of how an individual patient's outcome may differ under alternative treatment strategies. The ITE-Transformer learns temporally contextualized representations of patients' diagnosis and medication histories and subsequently uses these representations to predict treatment assignment, treatment-specific outcome risks, and patient-specific ITEs. The ITE-Transformer is trained using structured EHR data from ~350,000 participants in the All of Us Research Program and evaluated in two clinically different comparative-effectiveness tasks: (i) GLP-1 receptor agonists versus DPP-4 inhibitors among patients with type 2 diabetes, with major adverse cardiovascular events as the outcome, and (ii) immunotherapy versus chemotherapy in a pan-cancer cohort, with all-cause mortality as the outcome. Across both applications, the ITE-Transformer improves the discrimination and calibration of treatment assignment and outcome models compared with existing tabular machine learning approaches and an otherwise identical transformer trained without self-supervised pre-training. The ITE-Transformer further identifies substantial heterogeneity in predicted ITEs and yields interpretable patterns of treatment response associated with patients' diagnoses, medication histories, and comorbidities. Together, our work demonstrates how clinical foundation models can be developed for analyzing heterogeneity in treatment effects and thus support real-world evidence generation.

summary: 结合透明化全心脏光片显微成像与AI分析，在单细胞分辨率下绘制心梗后成纤维细胞相关基因表达。
key_points: 透明化全心脏光片成像
AI分析框架用于心梗表征
映射Postn、Cthrc1、Aspn表达
reason: 基础研究流程，AI为分析工具，增量档
abstract: [JCI insight] Cardiac fibroblasts (CFs) are key mediators of heart failure progression, driving fibrotic scar formation after myocardial infarction (MI). Conventional preclinical assessment of MI relies on two-dimensional histology, which cannot resolve the three-dimensional (3D) architecture of the injured heart. Understanding the molecular mechanisms of CF activation is critical for identifying new drug targets, yet spatial mapping of gene expression in intact hearts remains challenging. To address this, we developed a high-throughput imaging pipeline that combined single-cell-resolution gene expression profiling in cleared whole hearts with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy and an AI-driven analysis framework optimized for MI characterization. Using this approach, we mapped expression of periostin (Postn), collagen triple-helix repeat containing 1 (Cthrc1), and asporin (Aspn) - genes associated with CF activation. These markers were detected by day 3 post-infarction in the endocardium and border zone, preceding collagenous scar formation, then expanded across the infarcted myocardium before declining toward baseline during scar maturation. These findings revealed a spatially organized progression of fibrosis-associated gene expression that began in defined regions of the injured heart and subsequently extended throughout the infarcted myocardium. Whole-organ gene-expression imaging combined with deep-learning-based analysis enabled quantitative spatiotemporal mapping of molecular remodeling and provides a framework for investigating disease progression in intact organs.

title: Deep learning models detect neuromuscular disease and quantify functional impairment from video-derived biomechanics data.
zh_title: 视频生物力学深度学习检测神经肌肉病并量化功能损害
summary: 利用OpenCap智能手机视频运动学，对12种罕见遗传性神经肌肉病337人及78名对照，建立疾病检测与严重度量化方法。
key_points: 337名患者涵盖12种罕见病
78名年龄匹配健康对照
基于智能手机无标记动作捕捉
reason: 罕见病较大数据集、手机可扩展，但外部验证信息不明
abstract: [Research square] Measurements of human movement are critical for evaluating patients with neuromuscular diseases. However, current clinical tools are limited in sensitivity and can fail to detect the full spectrum of movement changes patients may exhibit. These limitations can obscure early signs of decline, delaying interventions that could preserve function and independence. OpenCap--a smartphone application that performs video-based markerless motion capture--can help address this gap by enabling scalable, out-of-lab measurements of human movement. Here, we present a method for both detecting disease and quantifying the severity of impaired movement from smartphone videos of a patient's motion. We used OpenCap to measure kinematics from 337 individuals with diagnoses spanning 12 rare, genetically-defined neuromuscular diseases and 78 age-matched healthy controls. Our dataset is the largest existing publicly available resource of body segment kinematics for this class of diseases. These data were collected in neuromuscular clinics during regular clinic visits as well as at conferences and community events across the United States. We trained deep learning models on these kinematic time series to differentiate between participants with neuromuscular disease and controls (AUROC = 0.97 [0.93-1.00]). We also developed a movement impairment severity score that correlates with both participants' ratings of their own functional abilities (ρ= -0.81, p < 0.001) and existing clinical tests of movement capabilities such as run speed (ρ= -0.83, p < 0.001). Our methods for detecting disease and deriving quantitative biomarkers of movement impairment from smartphone videos have the potential to complement clinical assessments, inform screening protocols, and improve clinical trial endpoints.

title: Accounting for Insulin-on-board in Large Language Model Advice about Pediatric Hyperglycemia.
source: PubMed · medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
zh_title: LLM儿童高血糖建议中对体内胰岛素的考量
summary: 研究测试多个LLM对儿童1型糖尿病高血糖照护者提问的回答，发现存在未提示考虑体内胰岛素就建议给药的潜在安全失误。
key_points: 测试4个LLM接口与2个聊天界面
出现未警示体内胰岛素的给药建议
失误率随餐食、胰岛素史等上下文变化
reason: 安全评估有价值，但范围有限、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] Large language models (LLMs) can be used by patients and caregivers to answer medical questions and the characterization of safety concerns in LLM outputs for patient-facing applications is an active area of research. In this work, we study LLM responses to caregiver questions about hyperglycemia in pediatric type 1 diabetes. We measure the frequency of a potential safety failure: advice to dose insulin in the absence of a clear warning to account for insulin-on-board. We found occurrences of the potential safety failure across four LLMs tested through programmatic endpoints and two LLMs tested through chat interfaces. The rates of the potential safety failure varied when different context was given about the patient's meal and insulin history and treatment regimen. These results highlight a need for guardrails for patients with diabetes who use LLMs to manage their care.
zh_abstract: [medRxiv：健康科学预印本服务器] 患者和照护者可以使用大语言模型（LLM）回答医学问题，而对面向患者的应用中LLM输出所含安全隐患的特征刻画是一个活跃的研究领域。在本研究中，我们考察了LLM对照护者关于儿童1型糖尿病高血糖问题的回答。我们测量了一种潜在安全失误的发生频率：在没有明确提示需考虑体内残余胰岛素（insulin-on-board）的情况下建议给予胰岛素剂量。我们发现，通过程序化接口测试的四个LLM以及通过聊天界面测试的两个LLM均出现了该潜在安全失误。当提供有关患者进餐和胰岛素使用史及治疗方案的不同背景信息时，该潜在安全失误的发生率有所不同。这些结果凸显了为使用LLM管理自身诊疗的糖尿病患者设置防护措施的必要性。

title: Artificial intelligence and triple negative breast cancer: can pathomics help oncologists?
zh_title: AI与三阴性乳腺癌：病理组学能否辅助肿瘤医生
summary: 综述梳理病理组学与深度学习全切片分析在三阴性乳腺癌分子分型、生物标志物、TIL及治疗反应预测中的应用。
key_points: 涵盖手工特征病理组学与深度学习WSI分析
探索多模态整合病理、组学与临床数据
用于分层、风险评估与治疗个体化
reason: 综述类上限6档，病理与治疗反应预测方向命中偏好
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive and heterogeneous subtype of breast cancer with limited targeted therapies and poor prognosis. Recent advances in digital pathology and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming traditional, qualitative histopathology into quantitative, data-driven analysis. Within computational pathology, pathomics (the extraction of handcrafted, high-dimensional features from digitized histological images) and deep learning (DL)-based whole-slide image analysis have been investigated for the prediction of molecular subtypes, biomarker expression, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and treatment response in TNBC. AI models, including DL and multimodal systems integrating histopathology, omics, and clinical data, are being explored for patient stratification, risk assessment, and therapy personalization, encompassing chemotherapy, immunotherapy, PARP inhibitors, and antibody-drug conjugates. By linking spatial tissue architecture with molecular profiles, these approaches may provide new insights into tumor biology and the tumor microenvironment. Most TNBC-specific studies are retrospective, small or single-center, few have been externally validated and, to our knowledge, none has yet demonstrated clinical utility in prospective trials; prediction of biomarkers such as PD-L1 or homologous recombination deficiency from hematoxylin and eosin slides remains investigational and cannot replace validated testing. Despite these challenges, AI-assisted computational pathology is a promising decision-support tool, which complements and does not replace pathologists and oncologists, for enhancing diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decision-making in TNBC.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是乳腺癌中一种侵袭性强且异质性高的亚型，靶向治疗手段有限，预后较差。数字病理学和人工智能（AI）的最新进展正在将传统的定性组织病理学转变为定量的、数据驱动的分析。在计算病理学中，病理组学（pathomics，即从数字化组织学图像中提取人工设计的高维特征）以及基于深度学习（DL）的全切片图像分析，已被用于预测 TNBC 的分子亚型、生物标志物表达、肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞和治疗反应。包括 DL 以及整合组织病理学、组学和临床数据的多模态系统在内的 AI 模型，正被探索用于患者分层、风险评估和治疗个体化，涵盖化疗、免疫治疗、PARP 抑制剂和抗体偶联药物。通过将组织空间结构与分子谱联系起来，这些方法可能为肿瘤生物学和肿瘤微环境提供新的见解。大多数 TNBC 特异性研究为回顾性、小样本或单中心研究，很少经过外部验证，且据我们所知，尚无研究在前瞻性试验中证明其临床效用；从苏木精-伊红染色切片预测 PD-L1 或同源重组缺陷等生物标志物仍处于研究阶段，不能取代经过验证的检测。尽管存在这些挑战，AI 辅助的计算病理学仍是一种有前景的决策支持工具，可补充而非取代病理科医生和肿瘤科医生，以改善 TNBC 的诊断、预后判断和治疗决策。

title: CryoID2: deep learning-enhanced identification of protein and RNA from cryoEM maps.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: CryoID2：深度学习识别冷冻电镜图中的蛋白与RNA
summary: CryoID2 用三个3D U-Net从冷冻电镜密度图预测结构特征，结合序列检索与结构拟合，从候选池中识别蛋白或RNA成分。
key_points: 三个3D U-Net提取结构类别、关键原子位置与残基类型
蛋白用BLASTp、RNA用maximin策略对候选排序
检索PDB/AlphaFold模型并按密度吻合度拟合排序
reason: 新方法有52例基准测试，但摘要缺外部验证细节，属值得一看档
abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Identifying the molecular components of cryoEM/cryoET maps of endogenous or poorly characterized complexes remains a major bottleneck. CryoID2 addresses this by integrating deep learning-based feature prediction with sequence prioritization and structural evaluation. Three 3D U-Nets extract structure classes, key-atom positions, and reduced residue/nucleotide types from the input map. These predictions support backbone tracing and the generation of short sequence queries that rank candidates from a user-supplied pool-using BLASTp for proteins and a maximin strategy for RNA. Corresponding PDB or AlphaFold models are then retrieved, rigidly fitted using predicted features and experimental density, and ranked by map agreement. Module-level tests show high-recall feature prediction and resolution-dependent atom clustering, while a 52-case benchmark recovers near-reference fitting quality. In practice, cryoID2 correctly identified PfA-M17 from a 166-protein mass-spectrometry pool and the unannotated Ca-raiA RNA from a genome-derived non-coding sequence set, demonstrating a unified sequence-plus-structure route to molecular identification in cryoEM maps.

title: "Pipe-Laying": A novel fusion of 3D MRI and health records for the early detection and diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease using deep learning.
zh_title: “Pipe-Laying”：融合3D MRI与健康记录的阿尔茨海默病早期检测深度学习
summary: 提出将3D MRI与文本型健康记录融合的深度学习方法，用于阿尔茨海默病早期检测与诊断，称优于分别分类再合并的做法。
key_points: 融合3D MRI与临床文本数据
针对分别建模后合并性能偏低的问题
面向AD早期诊断
reason: 多模态AD方法，摘要无外部验证，增量档
abstract: [PloS one] Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a prevalent form of dementia that impacts brain cells. Although its likelihood increases with age, there is no transitional period between its stages. In order to enhance diagnostic precision, physicians rely on clinical judgments derived from interpreting health data, considering demographics, clinical history, and laboratory results to detect AD at an early stage. While patient cognitive tests and demographic information are primarily presented in text, brain scan images are presented in graphic formats. Researchers typically use different classifiers for each data format and then merge the classifier outcomes to maximize classification accuracy and utilize all patient-related data for the final decision. However, this approach leads to low performance, diminishing predictive abilities and model effectiveness. We propose an innovative approach that combines diverse textual health records (HR) with three-dimensional structural magnetic resonance imaging (3D sMRI) to achieve a similar objective in computer-aided diagnosis, utilizing a novel deep learning technique. Health records, encompassing demographic features like age, gender, apolipoprotein gene, and mini-mental state examination score, are fused with 3D sMRI, enabling a graphic-based deep learning strategy for early AD detection. The fusion of data is accomplished by representing textual information as graphic pipes and integrating them into 3D sMRI, a method referred to as the "pipe-laying" method. This unified approach enables simultaneous processing of textual health records and 3D sMRI data within a single convolutional framework. Experimental results from over 4000 sMRI scans of 780 patients in the AD Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset demonstrate that the pipe-laying method enhances recognition accuracy rates for Early Mild Cognitive Impairment (EMCI) and Late Mild Cognitive Impairment (LMCI) patients, accurately classifying all AD patients. In a 4-class AD diagnosis scenario, encompassing AD, LMCI, EMCI, Cognitively Normal (CN) accuracy improved from 86.87% when only 3D images were used to 90.00% when 3D sMRI and patient health records were included. Thus, the positive impact of combining 3D sMRI with HR on 4-class AD diagnosis was established.

title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
zh_title: 从序列不确定性到表型假设：生物医学知识图谱上的不确定性条件推理
summary: 预印本提出不确定性条件路径能量框架，将基因组基础模型的序列预测及不确定性转化为知识图谱上的表型假设分布。
key_points: 无需患者级表型监督
可解释能量打分基因-疾病-表型路径
查询不确定性控制目标温度
reason: 新颖方法预印本，摘要缺实验结果；命中基因组基础模型方向
abstract: Genomic foundation models provide variant-level evidence, but connecting that evidence to phenotype hypotheses requires accounting for uncertainty throughout structured reasoning. We introduce an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into explicit distributions over graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, without patient-level phenotype supervision. An interpretable learned energy scores admissible gene--disease--phenotype routes, query uncertainty controls the target temperature, and path probabilities are aggregated into phenotype hypotheses. This formulation makes evidence quality an explicit determinant of hypothesis breadth while retaining traceable multi-path support. Exact normalization over enumerable candidate sets provides a reference for evaluating a Hastings-corrected learned revision operator. On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype-level entropy tracks upstream uncertainty, with Spearman correlations of 0.951 and 0.878, respectively; ablations identify the contribution of uncertainty conditioning. In masked-edge recovery, the model exceeds chance and degree-matched probability-permutation controls. Training the energy under the uncertainty-dependent temperature yields higher held-out recall@10 than training under a constant temperature of comparable magnitude. Under gene hold-out, recall@10 exceeds that of a trained DistMult embedding on 24 of 30 graph masks (0.183 versus 0.123); this difference is attributable mainly to three genes with many variants and is not established for all genes. These results establish an uncertainty-aware interface from genomic predictions to graph-supported phenotype hypotheses that combines interpretable probability allocation with held-out association recovery of explicitly stated scope.
zh_abstract: 基因组基础模型提供变异层面的证据，但将这些证据与表型假设联系起来，需要在整个结构化推理过程中考虑不确定性。我们提出一种不确定性条件化的路径能量框架，可在无需患者层面表型监督的情况下，将序列预测和校准后的预测不确定性转化为图支持的表型假设上的显式分布。一个可解释的习得能量对容许的基因–疾病–表型路径进行评分，查询不确定性控制目标温度，路径概率被聚合为表型假设。这一表述使证据质量成为假设广度的显式决定因素，同时保留可追溯的多路径支持。对可枚举候选集的精确归一化，为评估经 Hastings 校正的习得修正算子提供了参照。在 AlzKB 和 Hetionet 上，表型层面的熵与上游不确定性相关，Spearman 相关系数分别为 0.951 和 0.878；消融实验明确了不确定性条件化的贡献。在掩蔽边恢复任务中，该模型超过随机水平以及度匹配的概率置换对照。在依赖不确定性的温度下训练能量，所得留出集 recall@10 高于在量级相当的恒定温度下训练。在基因留出设置下，30 个图掩码中有 24 个的 recall@10 超过经训练的 DistMult 嵌入（0.183 对 0.123）；这一差异主要归因于三个具有大量变异的基因，并未在所有基因中得到证实。这些结果建立了一个从基因组预测到图支持的表型假设的不确定性感知接口，它将可解释的概率分配与范围明确限定的留出关联恢复结合起来。

title: Explainability of genotype embedding models through observed cohort paths
zh_title: 基于队列观测路径的基因型嵌入模型可解释性
summary: 指出积分梯度等路径归因方法不适用于离散等位基因剂量的嵌入模型，提出沿观测队列路径在嵌入空间中进行归因的思路。
key_points: 基因型模型仅在0/1/2剂量处定义嵌入
直线路径经过无效的分数基因型
需在嵌入空间中选择合理归因路径
reason: 预印本，针对基因-影像模型的新归因方法，摘要证据有限
abstract: Deep learning models that combine genotypes with neuroimaging predict neurological diseases more accurately than either modality alone. Their clinical use, however, requires identifying which genetic variants a prediction is based on. Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients address this by integrating the model's gradient from a baseline to the input. These methods assume the model accepts any point along that path as a valid input. Genotype models violate this assumption. They map the three discrete allele dosages \{0,1,2\} to vectors through a learned embedding defined only at those values, so a straight line passes through fractional genotypes at which no embedding, and therefore no gradient, exists. Attribution must therefore proceed in embedding space where the choice of path can affect the resulting attribution. We show that the commonly used per-variant estimator does not generally satisfy completeness. Additive separability guarantees completeness for this estimator, but interactions between variants generally break that property. Instead, we integrate along piecewise-linear embedding-space paths connecting genotype waypoints observed in the training cohort. Each path satisfies completeness in the continuum although the interiors of its segments are not necessarily observed. Our method improves faithfulness over Integrated Gradients and discretized Integrated Gradients under both perturbation protocols, achieves the strongest results for Parkinson's disease classification under support-preserving perturbations, and is competitive with a support-background Shapley baseline under per-variant perturbations. It also shows higher seed stability and better recovery of planted non-additive effects in a synthetic benchmark.
zh_abstract: 将基因型与神经影像相结合的深度学习模型，在预测神经系统疾病方面比任何单一模态都更准确。然而，其临床应用需要明确预测依据的是哪些基因变异。基于路径的归因方法（如积分梯度，Integrated Gradients）通过对模型从基线到输入沿路径的梯度进行积分来解决这一问题。这些方法假定模型可接受该路径上的任一点作为有效输入。而基因型模型违背了这一假设：它们通过仅在离散取值处定义的可学习嵌入，将三种离散的等位基因剂量 {0,1,2} 映射为向量，因此一条直线会经过分数型基因型，而在这些点上不存在嵌入，也就不存在梯度。因此，归因必须在嵌入空间中进行，而路径的选择会影响最终的归因结果。我们证明，常用的逐变异估计量一般并不满足完备性。可加可分性可保证该估计量满足完备性，但变异之间的相互作用通常会破坏这一性质。为此，我们沿着连接训练队列中观察到的基因型路标点的分段线性嵌入空间路径进行积分。每条路径在连续意义上满足完备性，尽管其各线段内部不一定是实际观察到的点。在两种扰动方案下，我们的方法在忠实性上均优于积分梯度和离散化积分梯度；在保持支撑集的扰动下，该方法在帕金森病分类中取得了最佳结果；在逐变异扰动下，其表现与支撑集背景 Shapley 基线相当。在一个合成基准中，它还表现出更高的随机种子稳定性，并能更好地恢复人为植入的非加性效应。

title: Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration
zh_title: 术中EEG与血流动力学风险校准：抗监护仪伪影与平滑滞后
summary: 在5,439例公开麻醉手术数据上构建因果信号调理与抗分布偏移的共形校准框架，用于术中风险预测。
key_points: 处理阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟与袖带伪影
比较树集成与深度序列模型
覆盖多种麻醉与镇静场景
reason: 公开数据较大样本，有新意但为预印本，证据有限
abstract: Commercial intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) and blood pressure monitors introduce cyclic impedance pulses, smoothing delays, direct-current (DC) drift, and cuff holds that confound risk forecasting and uncertainty calibration. We developed a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework across 5,439 public anesthesia procedures. Streaming filters blank 10.13-min 64-Hz impedance checks, apply unclipped post-notch conditioning, separate 63-s suppression-ratio lag, and distinguish three-channel cuff inflations from dropouts across propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA; N = 3,214), volatile anesthesia (N = 2,046), European endoscopy sedation (N = 171), and DC-coupled surgery (N = 8). De-impedanced cortical tree ensembles were compared against deep sequence models, paired with patient-cluster Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted Conformal Risk Control (CRC) and lag-buffered online Conformal Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) tracking. Pre-filter blanking removed 97.90% and 97.60% of false flatline conflicts while preserving 99.23% and 98.96% of deep suppression. On unseen TIVA surgeries (N = 525), cortical features achieved area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) 0.3135 (1.94% prevalence) and 0.1627 (0.82% lag-free prevalence), with no detectable difference from deep encoders (p >= 0.36) and no cortical gain for hypotension (0.3432 vs. 0.3437, p = 0.784). Zero-retraining volatile transfer (N = 1,048) showed no detectable difference from an end-tidal gas oracle on lag-free suppression (0.0820 vs. 0.0736, p = 0.472). Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted CRC bounded all 70 TIVA shift cells at <= 4.38% (alpha = 5.0%) in 66.32 ms per 30-s epoch. Causal artifact disentangling and shift-aware conformal calibration support reliable real-time intraoperative risk bounds within explicit physiological observability limits.
zh_abstract: 商用术中脑电图（EEG）和血压监护仪会引入周期性阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟、直流（DC）漂移和袖带保持，这些因素会干扰风险预测和不确定性校准。我们在 5,439 例公开麻醉手术中开发了一种因果信号调理与抗分布偏移的共形校准框架。流式滤波器对时长 10.13 分钟、64 Hz 的阻抗检测进行消隐，应用不截幅的陷波后调理，分离 63 秒的抑制比滞后，并区分三通道袖带充气与信号丢失，覆盖丙泊酚-瑞芬太尼全静脉麻醉（TIVA；N = 3,214）、挥发性麻醉（N = 2,046）、欧洲内镜镇静（N = 171）以及直流耦合手术（N = 8）。将去阻抗的皮层树集成模型与深度序列模型进行比较，并配合以患者簇为单位的亚组协变量加权共形风险控制（CRC）以及带滞后缓冲的在线共形比例-积分-微分（PID）跟踪。滤波前消隐分别去除了 97.90% 和 97.60% 的虚假平坦线冲突，同时保留了 99.23% 和 98.96% 的深度抑制。在未见过的 TIVA 手术（N = 525）中，皮层特征的精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）为 0.3135（患病率 1.94%）和 0.1627（无滞后患病率 0.82%），与深度编码器相比未检测到差异（p >= 0.36），且对低血压无皮层特征增益（0.3432 vs. 0.3437，p = 0.784）。零再训练的挥发性麻醉迁移（N = 1,048）在无滞后抑制方面与呼气末气体参照模型相比未检测到差异（0.0820 vs. 0.0736，p = 0.472）。亚组协变量加权 CRC 将全部 70 个 TIVA 偏移单元的风险限制在 <= 4.38%（alpha = 5.0%），每个 30 秒时段耗时 66.32 毫秒。因果伪迹解耦与偏移感知的共形校准，在明确的生理可观测性限制范围内，支持可靠的实时术中风险界限。

title: Modelling Phenotypic Assay Noise for Multivariable Biomarker Discovery using Deep Neural Networks
zh_title: 用深度神经网络建模表型实验噪声以发现多变量生物标志物
summary: 指出四个常用癌细胞系药敏筛选数据集存在测量噪声，并提出Deep Concordance Index Networks以改进药物反应预测。
key_points: 验证四个常用数据集存在表型噪声
提出DCIN深度网络方法
目标是避免模型学习实验伪影
reason: 新方法预印本，药物反应预测；摘要未见外部验证
abstract: Accurately predicting cancer drug response remains a major challenge in precision oncology. Although some therapies are guided by clinically-approved biomarkers, these markers often yield limited predictive value and are unavailable for many drugs. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning approaches trained on large-scale cancer cell line pharmacogenomic screens offer a promising route to more comprehensive response prediction, yet they generally assume that phenotypic readouts are measured without error. This assumption is problematic because viability-based drug response assays are inherently noisy, potentially causing models to learn experimental artefacts rather than biologically meaningful determinants of sensitivity. Here, we show that phenotypic measurement noise is present in four widely used cancer cell line screening datasets and introduce Deep Concordance Index Networks (DeepCINET), a deep learning framework that explicitly accounts for this noise. Across datasets, incorporating this noise-aware ranking strategy improves generalization across experimental conditions and to previously unseen samples. DeepCINET outperforms baseline models in multiple settings, with particularly notable gains in prioritizing the most drug-sensitive cell lines. Together, these results establish phenotypic assay noise as a critical and previously overlooked source of error in drug response modelling and provide a principled framework for noise-aware multivariable biomarker discovery.
zh_abstract: 准确预测癌症药物反应仍是精准肿瘤学的一大挑战。尽管部分疗法由临床批准的生物标志物指导，但这些标志物的预测价值往往有限，且许多药物并无可用的标志物。基于大规模癌细胞系药物基因组学筛选训练的人工智能和机器学习方法，为实现更全面的反应预测提供了有前景的途径，但它们通常假定表型读数的测量不存在误差。这一假设存在问题，因为基于细胞活力的药物反应检测本身就具有噪声，可能导致模型学到的是实验伪影，而非具有生物学意义的敏感性决定因素。在此，我们表明四个广泛使用的癌细胞系筛选数据集中均存在表型测量噪声，并提出深度一致性指数网络（Deep Concordance Index Networks，DeepCINET），这是一个显式考虑该噪声的深度学习框架。在各数据集中，引入这种噪声感知的排序策略可提升模型在不同实验条件下以及对未见样本的泛化能力。DeepCINET 在多种设置下优于基线模型，在优先识别对药物最敏感的细胞系方面提升尤为显著。总之，这些结果确立了表型检测噪声是药物反应建模中一个关键且此前被忽视的误差来源，并为噪声感知的多变量生物标志物发现提供了一个有原则的框架。

title: Improving Target-Adverse Event Association Prediction via Inverse Node Frequency Transformation to Mitigate Knowledge Graph Topological Bias
zh_title: 逆节点频率变换缓解知识图谱拓扑偏差以改进靶点-不良事件关联预测
summary: 预印本提出逆节点频率（INF）方法，缓解知识图谱中枢纽节点主导的度偏差，用于靶点与不良事件关联预测。
key_points: 针对知识图谱拓扑/度偏差
基于增强生物医学知识图谱与自建关联数据
关注新靶点或研究不足靶点的安全性推断
reason: 药物安全方向新方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Motivation: Identifying significant associations between therapeutic protein targets and adverse events (AEs) is a critical component of drug safety assessment. To accelerate the process, machine learning methods have been developed to predict these associations as edges in network data integrating molecular interactions and other key biomedical knowledge. However, these networks often suffer from topological imbalances where a minority of "hub" nodes determine the predictive signal. This "topological" or "degree bias" can lead to poor performance on novel or understudied targets where safety inference is most needed. Results: We introduce Inverse Node Frequency (INF), a generally applicable node degree-based approach for mitigating topological bias. Employing an enriched biomedical knowledge graph and our own carefully curated target-adverse event associations, we apply INF as a normalisation procedure on a class of graph-derived features called metapaths and evaluate their resulting target-AE association prediction performance. Our results demonstrate that INF significantly improves the true positive rate (TPR/recall) for low-degree targets compared to the untransformed metapath features as well as a popular established normalisation method, while also achieving highly competitive hits@k, a ranking-based metric for knowledge graph-based inference. We also evaluated INF on an external set of target-AE associations never before used for modelling, on which INF also showed superior resilience compared to the two benchmarks.
zh_abstract: 【动机】识别治疗性蛋白靶点与不良事件（AE）之间的显著关联，是药物安全性评估的关键环节。为加快这一过程，人们开发了机器学习方法，将这些关联作为整合分子相互作用及其他关键生物医学知识的网络数据中的边来预测。然而，这些网络常存在拓扑失衡，即少数“枢纽”节点决定预测信号。这种“拓扑”或“度偏倚”可能导致在新颖或研究不足的靶点上表现不佳，而这恰恰是最需要安全性推断的地方。【结果】我们提出了逆节点频率（Inverse Node Frequency，INF），这是一种基于节点度、可普遍适用的缓解拓扑偏倚的方法。我们利用一个经过扩充的生物医学知识图谱和我们自行精心整理的靶点-不良事件关联，将INF作为一种归一化程序应用于一类称为元路径（metapath）的图衍生特征，并评估其所得的靶点-AE关联预测性能。结果表明，与未经转换的元路径特征以及一种常用的成熟归一化方法相比，INF显著提高了低度靶点的真阳性率（TPR/召回率），同时在hits@k（一种基于排序、用于知识图谱推断的指标）上也取得了极具竞争力的表现。我们还在一组此前从未用于建模的外部靶点-AE关联上评估了INF，结果显示INF相较于这两种基准方法同样表现出更强的稳健性。

title: Automated Screening for Generalized Anxiety Disorder Using Voice Analysis and Machine Learning
zh_title: 基于语音分析与机器学习的广泛性焦虑筛查
summary: 在四个非洲国家1788名成人中，用远程采集的朗读语音训练模型筛查GAD-7≥5的焦虑症状，性能中等偏低。
key_points: 1788名成人，来自四国
声学模型最高AUC 0.594
加入情境信息后AUC 0.699
reason: 多国较大队列但仅内部交叉验证、性能有限；精神健康加分
abstract: This study evaluated machine learning models for screening elevated generalized anxiety symptoms from remotely collected neutral read speech in 1,788 adults from Botswana, Ghana, Nigeria, and Tanzania. Elevated symptoms were defined by Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7-item (GAD-7) questionnaire scores [≥] 5. Nine classifiers were assessed across nine scenarios defined by speech-task configuration (short sentence, long passage, or both tasks) and sex stratification under participant-separated, repeated nested cross-validation (CV). Acoustic-only models used the extended Geneva Minimalistic Acoustic Parameter Set, and context-augmented models added age, self-reported health, and sex where applicable. With feature selection, the highest mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCROC) was 0.594 for acoustic-only models and 0.699 for context-augmented models, the latter in the female-only combined-task scenario. Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) identified fundamental frequency descriptors as prominent acoustic predictors, while health status and age were the leading predictors in context-augmented models. Performance varied across scenarios, and feature selection provided no consistent benefit. Secondary regression poorly estimated continuous symptom severity. These findings indicate limited discrimination from neutral speech acoustics alone and improved performance with participant context, warranting external validation.

title: Effects of Artificial Intelligence Chatbot Interventions on Women during Pregnancy and Postpartum: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
zh_title: AI聊天机器人干预对孕产期女性效果的系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 系统检索多个数据库，评估AI聊天机器人干预对孕期及产后女性的效果。

abstract: [Healthcare informatics research] Artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used in maternal healthcare to provide real-time, interactive, personalized support. This systematic review and meta-analysis examined the effects of AI chatbot interventions on women during pregnancy and postpartum. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, Embase, the Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature, and the Research Information Sharing System were searched from September 11 to 16, 2025, using the search string "(("Artificial Intelligence"[Mesh] OR "AI"[tiab] OR "Machine Learning"[tiab]) AND ("Chatbot"[tiab] OR "Conversational Agent*"[tiab]) AND ("Pregnancy"[Mesh] OR prenatal[tiab] OR antenatal[tiab] OR postnatal[tiab] OR postpartum[tiab])". Eligible studies were peer-reviewed experimental studies published in English or Korean that evaluated chatbot interventions for women during pregnancy or postpartum. Six studies (four randomized controlled trials and two nonrandomized controlled trials) were included. Intervention themes included gestational diabetes, postpartum depression, well-being, maternal-fetal attachment, aneuploidy testing, and breastfeeding. Individual trials reported improvements in knowledge, self-efficacy, and attachment, as well as reductions in symptoms. The meta-analysis showed no significant effect on depression (estimate = 0.037, p = 0.662) or anxiety (estimate = -0.084, p = 0.279); heterogeneity was low (I² = 0%). AI chatbot interventions show promise for improving maternal knowledge, self-efficacy, and attachment. However, the available evidence does not show consistent reductions in depression or anxiety. Large, rigorously designed studies are needed to refine intervention strategies, ensure equity, and establish a robust basis for integrating these interventions into maternal healthcare systems.
zh_abstract: [医疗信息学研究] 人工智能（AI）聊天机器人越来越多地用于孕产妇保健，以提供实时、互动、个性化的支持。本系统评价和荟萃分析考察了AI聊天机器人干预对妊娠期及产后女性的影响。于2025年9月11日至16日检索了PubMed、Cochrane Library、Embase、护理及相关健康文献累积索引（Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature）和Research Information Sharing System，检索式为"(("Artificial Intelligence"[Mesh] OR "AI"[tiab] OR "Machine Learning"[tiab]) AND ("Chatbot"[tiab] OR "Conversational Agent*"[tiab]) AND ("Pregnancy"[Mesh] OR prenatal[tiab] OR antenatal[tiab] OR postnatal[tiab] OR postpartum[tiab])"。纳入标准为以英文或韩文发表、经同行评审、评价针对妊娠期或产后女性的聊天机器人干预的实验性研究。共纳入6项研究（4项随机对照试验和2项非随机对照试验）。干预主题包括妊娠期糖尿病、产后抑郁、幸福感、母胎依恋、非整倍体检测和母乳喂养。各项试验报告了知识、自我效能和依恋方面的改善，以及症状的减轻。荟萃分析显示，对抑郁（估计值=0.037，p=0.662）和焦虑（估计值=-0.084，p=0.279）均无显著影响；异质性较低（I²=0%）。AI聊天机器人干预在改善孕产妇知识、自我效能和依恋方面显示出前景。然而，现有证据并未显示其能持续降低抑郁或焦虑。需要开展大规模、设计严谨的研究，以完善干预策略、确保公平性，并为将这些干预整合进孕产妇医疗保健体系奠定坚实基础。

title: ClinDataBench: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Clinical Trial Analysis Dataset Construction
zh_title: ClinDataBench：评估LLM智能体构建临床试验分析数据集
summary: 预印本基于公开CDISC试点研究，构建基准评估LLM编码智能体从原始数据生成ADaM分析数据集的完整性与正确性。
key_points: 基于CDISC公开试点研究，智能体接收SDTM等输入
现有验证器只查结构，不查数值推导是否正确
面向FDA递交所需ADaM数据集的构建任务
reason: 新基准、智能体评测有新意，但预印本且规模信息有限
abstract: A new drug reaches patients only after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has reviewed its trial evidence, which every application carries as analysis datasets in the Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Analysis Data Model (ADaM) format that programmers derive by hand from raw trial data, a statistical analysis plan (SAP) and dataset specifications. Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) could take over this work, and a slow-changing industry will adopt them only with evidence of what they get right and wrong. However, work on large language models (LLMs) for CDISC data stops short of evaluating a complete, conformant and reproducible package, and the standard validator checks structure rather than whether each value is derived correctly. We introduce ClinDataBench, built on the public CDISC pilot study: an agent receives 22 Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) domains, the statistical analysis plan (SAP) and specifications, and must deliver 13 Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, Define-XML metadata and a program that rebuilds them offline. Agents run in containers whose only network route is their model API, restricting online access to published reference outputs during execution. A host-only evaluator scores conformance under the Pinnacle 21 Community (P21) validator, selected derivations, clean reconstruction and effort separately. We compare three settings: Base, which submits the agent's first package; Self-Refine, which revises it without external validation feedback; and CRITIC, which revises it with the agent's own validator report. In an exploratory pilot with six models, the three closed models and DeepSeek delivered all 13 datasets in every setting and eleven of their twelve packages rebuilt semantically, while two other open-weight models delivered no complete package. Validator findings ranged from 15 to 64 dataset-rule pairs. Four of six CRITIC workflows had usable validator comparisons, and each reduced its finding count. None reduced its failed derivation count. The package with the fewest findings carried none of the 234 efficacy summary records in the form the specifications define, showing that lower validator finding counts do not necessarily indicate more correct derivations.

abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] Depression and anxiety are often assessed weeks or months apart with brief questionnaires covering few symptoms, leaving changes between assessments unobserved. Here, we introduce TALQ, a scoring system in which a large language model rates 52 symptoms from text, and use it to score 491 members of two online mental health communities every two weeks for a year. Ratings were stable across samples, predicted human annotations of interpersonal risk factors, low self-esteem and depression severity, and agreed with inventories completed by the same model. The scores mapped into 12 replicable symptom factors, including fearful preoccupation and social strain. Sleep disturbance and self-harm content consistently preceded overwhelm and emotional pain, respectively, two weeks later. People differed mainly in the states they occupied rather than transitions between them, and 13% entered in a crisis that remitted over months. Overall, our findings suggest that TALQ can measure expressed mental states densely and quantify longitudinal dynamics.

title: When Artificial Intelligence Plays It Safe: Large Language Models Preserve Surgical Sensitivity at the Cost of Diagnostic Specificity in Acute Abdominal Pain.
zh_title: 前沿大模型在急腹症中保敏感性却牺牲特异性
summary: 用50例合成病例评估三种前沿LLM，探索其在急腹症诊断中敏感性与特异性的权衡。
key_points: 50例标准化合成病例，各25例
GPT-5.5精确诊断准确率92.0%
Gemini 3.0 Ultra为76.0%
reason: 合成小样本探索性评估，无真实患者，属增量档
abstract: [The American surgeon] BackgroundIn acute abdominal pain, artificial intelligence may appear safe by preserving surgical sensitivity while increasing resource use through reduced specificity. We evaluated this safety-stewardship trade-off across frontier large language models (LLMs) to provide an exploratory diagnostic benchmark.MethodsWe performed a cross-sectional in-silico study using 50 standardized synthetic vignettes (25 urgent surgical, 25 non-urgent) internally developed by our investigative group. GPT-5.5, Claude 4.0 Opus, and Gemini 3.0 Ultra were evaluated using identical zero-shot deterministic prompting against an internally established, blinded dual-specialty expert consensus.ResultsExact primary-diagnosis accuracy was 92.0% (95% CI, 81.2-96.8%) for GPT-5.5, 88.0% (95% CI, 76.2-94.4%) for Claude 4.0 Opus, and 76.0% (95% CI, 62.6-85.7%) for Gemini 3.0 Ultra. Surgical sensitivity remained high across models (84.0% to 96.0%), whereas specificity was lower (64.0% to 80.0%) than specialist consensus. Models demonstrated a conservative escalation pattern with frequent over-triage decisions. Positive likelihood ratios ranged from 2.33 to 4.60. Over-investigation bias was the predominant error pattern.ConclusionIn this exploratory benchmark, frontier LLMs consistently prioritized surgical sensitivity over specificity in internally authored structured acute-abdomen vignettes. These findings reflect differences in performance on controlled synthetic scenarios rather than independently validated clinical diagnostic accuracy. Claims regarding clinical patient safety or readiness for implementation require future prospective validation with independent, real-world clinical cases and external multidisciplinary adjudication.
zh_abstract: [The American surgeon] 【背景】在急性腹痛中，人工智能可能通过保持外科敏感性而显得安全，但同时因特异性降低而增加资源使用。我们在多个前沿大语言模型（LLM）中评估了这种安全性-资源管理之间的权衡，以提供一项探索性诊断基准。【方法】我们开展了一项横断面计算机模拟研究，使用由本研究小组内部编制的50个标准化合成病例（25个紧急外科病例，25个非紧急病例）。GPT-5.5、Claude 4.0 Opus和Gemini 3.0 Ultra采用相同的零样本确定性提示，以内部建立的、盲法的双专科专家共识作为对照进行评估。【结果】GPT-5.5的主要诊断完全准确率为92.0%（95% CI，81.2-96.8%），Claude 4.0 Opus为88.0%（95% CI，76.2-94.4%），Gemini 3.0 Ultra为76.0%（95% CI，62.6-85.7%）。各模型的外科敏感性均保持较高（84.0%至96.0%），而特异性（64.0%至80.0%）低于专家共识。模型表现出保守的升级模式，频繁出现过度分诊决策。阳性似然比为2.33至4.60。过度检查偏倚是主要的错误模式。【结论】在这一探索性基准中，前沿LLM在内部编写的结构化急腹症病例中一贯优先考虑外科敏感性而非特异性。这些发现反映的是在受控合成场景中的表现差异，而非经独立验证的临床诊断准确性。关于临床患者安全或可用于实施的任何结论，都需要未来使用独立的真实世界临床病例并经外部多学科裁定进行前瞻性验证。
