abstract: [American journal of speech-language pathology] The purpose of this project was to evaluate the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT's responses to questions related to common misconceptions about dyslexia. Three content area experts independently rated the accuracy of ChatGPT's responses to five questions related to common misconceptions about dyslexia. Ratings were averaged across raters to derive an overall accuracy score for each response. ChatGPT's responses were also analyzed for length, reading time, reading ease, and reading level. The overall accuracy of ChatGPT's responses was high. However, without additional prompting to adjust the length and/or reading level, ChatGPT's responses were written for advanced readers and took up to 2 min to read. This study provides preliminary evidence that, at present, ChatGPT may be a useful tool for procuring scientifically valid information about dyslexia. Limitations and future directions are discussed.
zh_abstract: [美国言语语言病理学杂志] 本项目旨在评估 ChatGPT 对有关诵读困难（dyslexia）常见误解问题的回答的准确性和可读性。三位内容领域专家独立评定了 ChatGPT 对五个有关诵读困难常见误解的问题的回答的准确性。对各评分者的评分取平均值，得出每条回答的总体准确性得分。同时还分析了 ChatGPT 回答的长度、阅读时间、阅读难易度和阅读水平。ChatGPT 回答的总体准确性较高。然而，在未额外提示调整长度和/或阅读水平的情况下，ChatGPT 的回答是面向高阶读者撰写的，阅读耗时最长可达 2 分钟。本研究提供了初步证据，表明目前 ChatGPT 可能是获取有关诵读困难的科学有效信息的有用工具。文中还讨论了研究的局限性和未来方向。

title: AI-driven reconstruction of maxillary complete denture bases: a clinical feasibility study.
zh_title: AI重建上颌全口义齿基托：临床可行性研究
summary: 基于口内扫描数据，用带边缘注意力的改进PointNet++重建上颌全口义齿基托，在79例患者数据上评估可行性。
key_points: 79例数据，57训练、7验证、15测试
模型在训练中强调基托边缘特征
以点云几何指标评估重建性能
reason: 单中心小样本可行性研究，仅内部测试
abstract: [Clinical oral investigations] Digital denture workflows remain limited by the inability of intraoral scanners (IOS) to capture functional soft-tissue dynamics and peripheral border molding. This clinical feasibility study evaluated whole-surface geometric reconstruction of maxillary complete denture bases from IOS data using a novel artificial intelligence (AI) model in which peripheral border features were emphasized during training. IOS datasets of the edentulous maxilla and corresponding clinically acceptable dentures from 79 patients were used to train an enhanced PointNet + + model incorporating a border-attention mechanism. The dataset was divided into 57 training, 7 validation, and 15 test cases. Whole-surface point-cloud performance was evaluated in the held-out test set using Density-Aware Chamfer Distance, maximum Hausdorff distance, and multi-threshold precision, recall, and F-scores. Whole-surface registration RMSE was additionally calculated for three randomly selected test-set cases that underwent additive manufacturing and an exploratory clinical try-in. On an independent test set, the mean Chamfer Distance was 2.6 ± 0.1 mm and the maximum Hausdorff distance was 2.4 mm. F-scores increased from 0.8 at a 0.5-mm tolerance to 1.0 at a 2.0-mm tolerance. Whole-surface RMSE values for the three pilot cases ranged from 0.4 to 0.6 mm. The additively manufactured AI denture bases showed promising adaptation and positional stability in this pilot evaluation; however, conventionally fabricated dentures provided superior retention. Within the study's limitations, the AI model showed potential for whole-surface reconstruction of maxillary denture bases from IOS data. However, in the descriptive try-in of three cases, the patients' existing conventional dentures were subjectively more retentive than the additively manufactured AI-generated bases. AI-based denture-base reconstruction from IOS data may contribute to future fully digital workflows. Before clinical implementation, border-specific geometric validation, larger external datasets, and objective measurements of retention, adaptation, and positional stability are required.

title: Integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence-Based Concept Mapping to Enhance Nursing Students' Critical Thinking, Cognitive Load, and Self-Efficacy.
zh_title: 生成式AI概念图提升护生批判性思维与自我效能
summary: 准实验研究比较AI概念图与传统概念图在产科护理教学中的效果，AI组认知负荷更低、批判性思维和自我效能提升。
key_points: 准实验前后测设计
AI组认知负荷显著降低
批判性思维与自我效能提高
reason: 医学教育小规模准实验，增量档
abstract: [Computers, informatics, nursing : CIN] Entrustable professional activities are important for training nursing students and enhancing their abilities to manage and care for pregnant women through clinical case studies. This study explored a generative artificial intelligence (AI)-based concept mapping (CM) approach within this framework to improve nursing students' learning outcomes in obstetrics education, focusing on critical thinking, cognitive load, and self-efficacy. Using a quasi-experimental design with pre-test and post-test evaluations, this study compared the effects of an AI-based CM activity with a conventional CM method. Results showed the AI-based approach significantly reduced cognitive load and improved students' critical thinking and self-efficacy. This innovative method demonstrated potential as an effective teaching strategy in nursing education. Nursing educators could incorporate such technologies to better support students' development in entrustable professional activities.
zh_abstract: [计算机、信息学、护理 CIN] 可托付专业活动（entrustable professional activities）对于培养护理学生、提升其通过临床案例管理和护理孕妇的能力十分重要。本研究在此框架下探讨了一种基于生成式人工智能（AI）的概念图（CM）方法，以改善护理学生在产科教育中的学习结果，重点关注批判性思维、认知负荷和自我效能。本研究采用带有前测和后测评估的准实验设计，比较了基于 AI 的 CM 活动与传统 CM 方法的效果。结果显示，基于 AI 的方法显著降低了认知负荷，并提高了学生的批判性思维和自我效能。这种创新方法显示出作为护理教育中有效教学策略的潜力。护理教育者可纳入此类技术，以更好地支持学生在可托付专业活动方面的发展。

title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
zh_title: 专家表现漂移下的延迟决策学习
summary: 提出EDA-L2D框架，利用专家近期结果历史建模其可靠性的时间漂移，以自适应地将决策交由人类专家处理。
key_points: 指出现有L2D假设专家可靠性固定
用序列模型对近期专家结果建模
提及放射科等高风险场景
reason: 人机协作方法预印本，医疗针对性弱，证据有限
abstract: The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert. However, most prior work on L2D assumes fixed expert reliability, overlooking temporal fluctuations in human performance due to factors such as fatigue and cognitive biases. Humans commonly exhibit such substantial, systematic performance shifts across a wide range of domains, from high-stakes settings such as radiology, aviation, and judicial decision-making, to everyday tasks such as crowdsourced image annotation. We propose Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer (EDA-L2D), a novel expert-aware L2D framework that explicitly models these temporal shifts by conditioning the deferral head on recent histories of expert outcomes via a sequence model. This history-aware approach enables adaptive deferral policies that anticipate reliability fluctuations and better allocate decisions between human and machine over time. We provide comprehensive experiments across three diverse tasks -- image classification, medical diagnosis, and hate speech detection -- including generalization analyses under realistic deferral conditions and irregular shifts in expert reliability. Our results show that EDA-L2D adapts more effectively than prior L2D methods to diverse temporal patterns of expert reliability, resulting in improved system performance and more effective deferral decisions. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiyaoMou/L2D-Expert-Drift.
zh_abstract: “学习转交”（learning to defer，L2D）框架通过将困难或关键的决策分配给人类专家，来保障机器学习和人工智能系统的安全性。然而，以往大多数 L2D 研究都假定专家的可靠性是固定的，忽视了由疲劳和认知偏差等因素导致的人类表现的时间波动。在从放射学、航空和司法决策等高风险场景，到众包图像标注等日常任务的广泛领域中，人类普遍表现出这种显著而系统的表现变化。我们提出“专家漂移适应的学习转交”（Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer，EDA-L2D），这是一种新颖的、具备专家感知能力的 L2D 框架，它通过序列模型，使转交头（deferral head）以专家近期的结果历史为条件，从而显式地对这些时间变化进行建模。这种基于历史信息的方法能够形成自适应的转交策略，预判可靠性的波动，并随时间推移更好地在人与机器之间分配决策。我们在三项不同的任务——图像分类、医学诊断和仇恨言论检测——上开展了全面实验，其中包括在现实转交条件和专家可靠性不规则变化下的泛化分析。结果表明，与以往的 L2D 方法相比，EDA-L2D 能更有效地适应专家可靠性的各种时间模式，从而提升系统性能并做出更有效的转交决策。代码可在 https://github.com/ZiyaoMou/L2D-Expert-Drift 获取。

title: Bayesian optimization on amortized search space
zh_title: 摊销搜索空间上的贝叶斯优化：帕金森给药个性化
summary: 预印本提出利用模拟器的摊销逆映射限制贝叶斯优化搜索空间，给出遗憾界，并以帕金森病药物剂量个性化PK/PD模拟为例。
key_points: 用摊销逆映射缩小搜索空间并保留原几何核
刻画近似偏差与信息增益，推导内在维度相关遗憾率
以帕金森病给药个性化为应用示例
reason: 方法新颖有理论，但应用为模拟示例，预印本，属增量档
abstract: In real-world black-box optimization problems, a mechanistic simulator is often available that approximately predicts the behavior of the system as a function of the parameters being optimized. Here, we show how an amortized inverse map of such a simulator can be used in Bayesian optimization to restrict the search space while using a Gaussian process kernel that is aware of the original problem geometry. This allows for efficiently leveraging the low intrinsic dimensionality of the optimization problem. We characterize its approximation bias and information gain, and derive an intrinsic-dimension-dependent regret rate under additional geometric and Gaussian Process assumptions. We illustrate the method with an application to drug dosing personalization in Parkinson's disease. We use, as a simulator, a pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) model of a drug, a mechanistic model calibrated on population data with quantified parameter uncertainty. A dosing neural network is trained offline against the model, amortizing the map from patient PK/PD parameters to the regimen predicted to be optimal, and online Bayesian optimization then searches over this learned, low-dimensional representation rather than over raw dosages. Numerical simulations demonstrate the improved performance of our method in this application, as well as under simulator misspecification.

title: Statistical, Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods for Missing Covariates: An Empirical Evaluation with Applications to Alzheimer's Disease Research
zh_title: 缺失协变量处理方法实证评估：以阿尔茨海默病研究为例
summary: 通过模拟比较八种缺失协变量处理方法（含统计、机器学习与深度学习），并应用于阿尔茨海默病研究，该预印本未经同行评审。
key_points: 比较完整病例、多重插补、ML与DL等八种方法
涵盖MLP、VAE、GAN等深度学习框架
在不同缺失机制下做大量模拟评估
reason: 方法学比较，有一定参考价值，但无新方法与外部验证
abstract: Missing data are common in biomedical research, particularly when biomarkers are costly or require invasive procedures to obtain, such as cerebrospinal fluid measures in Alzheimer's disease. Although a wide range of missing data methods exists, from traditional statistical approaches to modern machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms, their comparative performance under different missingness mechanisms remains insufficiently understood. In this study, we provide an empirical evaluation of eight methods for handling missing covariates, including complete-case analysis, multiple imputation, ML-based techniques, and DL frameworks such as multilayer perceptrons, variational autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks. We summarize their conceptual foundations, practical implementation considerations, strengths, and limitations. Through extensive simulations, we assess estimation bias, efficiency, standard error accuracy, confidence interval coverage, and computational burden across different missingness mechanisms and proportions. An application to the Vanderbilt Memory and Aging Project further illustrates the implications of different methods for regression analysis in a real-world biomedical setting. Finally, we provide practical recommendations for method selection and highlight remaining challenges that warrant future investigation.
zh_abstract: 缺失数据在生物医学研究中十分常见，尤其是在生物标志物成本高昂或需要有创操作才能获得的情况下，例如阿尔茨海默病中的脑脊液检测。尽管已有多种处理缺失数据的方法，从传统统计方法到现代机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）算法，但它们在不同缺失机制下的比较性能仍缺乏充分认识。在本研究中，我们对八种处理缺失协变量的方法进行了实证评估，包括完整病例分析、多重插补、基于ML的技术，以及多层感知机、变分自编码器和生成对抗网络等DL框架。我们总结了这些方法的概念基础、实际实施中的考量、优势和局限性。通过大量模拟，我们评估了在不同缺失机制和缺失比例下的估计偏倚、效率、标准误准确性、置信区间覆盖率和计算负担。对范德比尔特记忆与衰老项目（Vanderbilt Memory and Aging Project）的应用进一步说明了不同方法对真实生物医学场景中回归分析的影响。最后，我们提出了方法选择的实用建议，并指出了仍需未来研究的挑战。

title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Shear Wave Speed Estimation in MR Elastography
zh_title: 物理信息深度学习用于磁共振弹性成像剪切波速估计
summary: 提出端到端框架，将神经网络正则化重建与k-MDEV相位梯度反演结合，从欠采样k空间直接估计剪切波速，在回顾性欠采样脑MRE数据上评估。
key_points: 重建模块与SWS反演模块串联可端到端训练
直接从欠采样k空间估计剪切波速
仅回顾性脑MRE数据评估，未经同行评审
reason: 预印本，回顾性脑MRE，新方法但证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Objective: Magnetic Resonance Elastography (MRE) is a non-invasive imaging technique for mapping biomechanical properties of in vivo tissue, including shear wave speed (SWS), but involves intrinsically slow data acquisition and an ill-posed wave inversion. Instead of relying on handcrafted image priors, we propose a data-driven approach jointly combining image reconstruction and MRE inversion for robust SWS estimation from undersampled k-space data. Methods: Our physics-informed reconstruction framework comprises two blocks: a model-based neural network (NN)-regularized reconstruction module and a phase-gradient inversion (k-MDEV) calculating SWS from the reconstructed images. Concatenating both blocks yields an end-to-end trainable method to estimate SWS directly from measured k-space data. We evaluated the method on retrospectively highly undersampled brain MRE data and compared it to a total variation (TV) minimization-based approach. We assessed the impact of end-to-end training (qualitative images and SWS maps as targets) versus pre-training (qualitative images as targets) and applied the method also to in vivo data. Results: Our approach significantly reduces NRMSE by 30% compared to TV. End-to-end training improves SWS estimation over separate image reconstruction and SWS calculation. Conclusion: Accurate SWS quantification is possible at acceleration factors up to 19. Our method significantly outperforms TV, highlighting the need for data-driven regularization in this challenging MR problem. Further, our approach successfully generalizes to in vivo data. Significance: We present the first end-to-end trainable MRE reconstruction method for estimating SWS maps directly from k-space. NN-based reconstruction can enable rapid stiffness mapping for dynamic studies, functional imaging, and real-time clinical feedback.
zh_abstract: 【目的】磁共振弹性成像（MRE）是一种无创成像技术，可用于绘制活体组织的生物力学特性（包括剪切波速度，SWS），但其数据采集过程本质上较慢，且波反演问题是病态的。我们不依赖手工设计的图像先验，而是提出一种数据驱动的方法，将图像重建与 MRE 反演联合起来，以便从欠采样 k 空间数据中稳健地估计 SWS。【方法】我们的物理信息重建框架包含两个模块：一个基于模型的神经网络（NN）正则化重建模块，以及一个相位梯度反演模块（k-MDEV），用于根据重建图像计算 SWS。将两个模块串联起来，即得到一种可端到端训练的方法，可直接从测得的 k 空间数据估计 SWS。我们在回顾性高度欠采样的脑部 MRE 数据上评估了该方法，并将其与基于总变分（TV）最小化的方法进行比较。我们评估了端到端训练（以定性图像和 SWS 图为目标）与预训练（以定性图像为目标）的影响，并将该方法也应用于活体数据。【结果】与 TV 相比，我们的方法使 NRMSE 显著降低 30%。与分别进行图像重建和 SWS 计算相比，端到端训练可改善 SWS 估计。【结论】在高达 19 倍的加速因子下仍可实现准确的 SWS 定量。我们的方法显著优于 TV，凸显了在这一具有挑战性的磁共振问题中采用数据驱动正则化的必要性。此外，我们的方法能够成功推广到活体数据。【意义】我们提出了首个可端到端训练的 MRE 重建方法，可直接从 k 空间估计 SWS 图。基于 NN 的重建可为动态研究、功能成像和实时临床反馈提供快速的硬度成像。

title: GPU-Accelerated Secure Inference for Drug--Target Interaction Prediction
zh_title: 面向药物-靶点相互作用预测的GPU加速安全推理
summary: 针对iDASH 2026赛道III，通过MPC友好模型SlimDTA与协议协同设计，在两方安全多方计算下于GPU上加速DTI推理，保护候选药物隐私。
key_points: 两服务器MPC下对秘密分享药物做预测
设计SlimDTA以减少非线性运算
模型与协议协同设计
reason: 竞赛方案预印本，隐私计算工程优化，摘要证据有限
abstract: Deep learning models that predict drug--target interactions (DTI) can speed up drug discovery, but the candidate drugs they score are valuable intellectual property that their owners cannot reveal. Secure multiparty computation (MPC) lets two servers compute a prediction on a secret-shared drug, without either server learning the drug. However, secure inference of deep models is slow. Non-linear operations require communication between the servers, and MPC arithmetic does not map naturally to GPUs. In this paper, we present our solution to Track~III of the iDASH 2026 privacy and security competition, which asked for fast two-party secure DTI inference on GPUs. Our solution is built on the co-design of MPC-friendly models and MPC protocols. On the model side, we design SlimDTA, a DTI model that reduces the operations on the secret drug, and in particular the non-linear operations that require communication. On the protocol side, we build a GPU framework that evaluates the linear layers with additive secret sharing and the non-linear layers with function secret sharing, including a custom CUDA kernel for the comparisons. Our solution won first place in the competition, at under 10,ms per prediction on average, and its secure predictions match the plaintext model to within 0.02%.
zh_abstract: 预测药物—靶点相互作用（DTI）的深度学习模型可以加速药物研发，但其所评分的候选药物是其所有者无法公开的宝贵知识产权。安全多方计算（MPC）使两台服务器能够对秘密共享的药物进行预测计算，而任何一台服务器都无法获知该药物。然而，深度模型的安全推理速度较慢。非线性运算需要服务器之间进行通信，且 MPC 算术并不能自然地映射到 GPU 上。本文介绍了我们针对 iDASH 2026 隐私与安全竞赛 Track III 的解决方案，该赛道要求在 GPU 上实现快速的双方安全 DTI 推理。我们的方案建立在对 MPC 友好型模型与 MPC 协议的协同设计之上。在模型方面，我们设计了 SlimDTA，这是一种 DTI 模型，可减少对秘密药物的运算，尤其是需要通信的非线性运算。在协议方面，我们构建了一个 GPU 框架，使用加法秘密共享计算线性层，使用函数秘密共享（function secret sharing）计算非线性层，其中包括用于比较运算的自定义 CUDA 内核。我们的方案在竞赛中获得第一名，平均每次预测耗时不到 10 ms，其安全预测结果与明文模型的差异在 0.02% 以内。

title: QUBO-based feature selection for MRI undersampling pattern design
zh_title: 基于QUBO特征选择的MRI欠采样模式设计
summary: 将MRI欠采样掩码设计表述为特征子集选择，用互信息构建QUBO模型并以模拟退火和量子退火求解，在fastMRI膝关节数据上评估零填充重建。
key_points: 每条采样线作为二值特征
用MI与CMI加采样数惩罚构建QUBO
在15%–40%六种采样率下测试
reason: 预印本，新颖优化表述，仅零填充模拟评估，增量档
abstract: We formulate undersampling mask design for Cartesian magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as a feature subset selection problem. Each sampling line is represented by a binary feature indicating whether it is included in each candidate mask. Using candidate masks and their training-set evaluations, we estimate mutual information (MI) and conditional mutual information (CMI). These estimates and a sampling-count penalty define a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model. The model is solved using simulated annealing and quantum annealing to determine a feature subset and its corresponding sampling mask. We assess the selected subsets on the test set through zero-filled reconstruction in Fourier undersampling simulations using fastMRI knee magnitude reference images, with patient-disjoint training and test sets. At all six tested target sampling rates from 15% to 40%, the resulting reconstructions have lower mean root mean square error than those obtained with four conventional sampling methods. They also have higher mean structural similarity than those obtained using univariate mutual-information ranking at all tested rates. These results support information-theoretic feature selection as an approach to MRI undersampling mask design under the tested zero-filled simulation settings.
zh_abstract: 我们将笛卡尔磁共振成像（MRI）的欠采样掩模设计表述为特征子集选择问题。每条采样线由一个二值特征表示，指示其是否包含在各个候选掩模中。利用候选掩模及其在训练集上的评估结果，我们估计互信息（MI）和条件互信息（CMI）。这些估计值与采样数惩罚项共同定义了一个二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）模型。该模型采用模拟退火和量子退火求解，以确定特征子集及其对应的采样掩模。我们使用 fastMRI 膝关节幅值参考图像，在傅里叶欠采样模拟中通过零填充重建，在训练集与测试集患者互不重叠的测试集上评估所选子集。在 15% 至 40% 的全部六个测试目标采样率下，所得重建的平均均方根误差均低于四种传统采样方法。在所有测试采样率下，其平均结构相似性也高于单变量互信息排序方法。这些结果支持在所测试的零填充模拟设置下，将信息论特征选择作为 MRI 欠采样掩模设计的一种方法。

title: NeuroSim: a clinically informed multi-disorder EEG simulator with personalized pattern injection and AI-driven neurological modeling
zh_title: NeuroSim：多疾病EEG模拟器与个性化模式注入
summary: 预印本提出可生成含阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、精神分裂症、癫痫和额颞叶痴呆等特征的合成多通道EEG的模拟框架。
key_points: 覆盖五种神经精神疾病及多种严重程度
生理启发的基线生成器，含节律、ERP与伪迹
旨在缓解标注EEG稀缺与隐私共享限制
reason: 合成数据框架，摘要未见临床验证，预印本；痴呆方向略加分
abstract: Deep learning for electroencephalography (EEG) based neurodiagnostics is constrained by the limited availability of labeled clinical recordings. Datasets covering Alzheimers disease (AD), Parkinsons disease (PD), schizophrenia (SCZ), epilepsy (EPI), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) are scarce, demographically narrow, and heterogeneous across acquisition sites, while privacy requirements restrict data sharing. Existing EEG simulators typically address a single disorder or trade biological interpretability for statistical fidelity. This study presents NeuroSim, a simulation framework that generates synthetic multichannel EEG with user-controlled injection of disease-specific patterns across five disorders and multiple severity levels. A physiologically motivated baseline generator produces band-limited rhythms, event-related potentials, artifacts, and hierarchical subject-level and trial-level variability. Disease patterns are introduced through region-specific and severity-specific spectral modulation that encodes established biomarkers, including posterior alpha suppression in AD, motor beta enhancement in PD, and spike-wave discharges in EPI. An interactive interface exposes montage, sampling rate, duration, artifacts, stimuli, affected regions, and severity, and exports signals with reproducible metadata. The simulated signals reproduced the expected biomarker directionality under spectral, topographic, and multivariate statistical analysis. A convolutional-attention classifier trained on simulated data reached 95.3 to 96.8 percent hold-out accuracy, and post hoc explainability analyses produced class-separable embeddings with attributions concentrated on pathophysiologically expected electrodes. Application of the analysis pipeline to recordings from the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus confirmed compatibility with heterogeneous clinical data. In subject-level augmentation experiments on real clinical EEG, supplementing real training data with NeuroSim samples increased classification accuracy from 91.6 to 94.5 percent for AD versus healthy controls and from 90.9 to 94.0 percent for PD versus healthy controls, exceeding the improvement obtained with conventional signal-level augmentation. NeuroSim is released as open-source software to support augmentation, benchmarking, and explainable artificial intelligence in neurological diagnostics.
zh_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）的神经诊断深度学习受限于带标注临床记录的有限可得性。涵盖阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、精神分裂症（SCZ）、癫痫（EPI）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的数据集稀缺、人口学特征覆盖面窄、各采集站点间存在异质性，同时隐私要求限制了数据共享。现有 EEG 模拟器通常只针对单一疾病，或以牺牲生物学可解释性来换取统计保真度。本研究提出 NeuroSim，一个可生成合成多通道 EEG 的模拟框架，允许用户控制在五种疾病及多个严重程度水平下注入疾病特异性模式。基于生理学原理的基线生成器可产生带限节律、事件相关电位、伪迹，以及受试者层面和试次层面的层级变异。疾病模式通过区域特异性和严重程度特异性的频谱调制引入，编码了已确立的生物标志物，包括 AD 中的后部 alpha 抑制、PD 中的运动区 beta 增强以及 EPI 中的棘慢波放电。交互式界面可设置电极导联布局（montage）、采样率、时长、伪迹、刺激、受累区域和严重程度，并导出带有可复现元数据的信号。经频谱分析、地形图分析和多变量统计分析，模拟信号再现了预期的生物标志物方向性。在模拟数据上训练的卷积-注意力分类器达到 95.3% 至 96.8% 的留出集准确率，事后可解释性分析得到了类别可分的嵌入，其归因集中于病理生理学上预期的电极。将该分析流程应用于天普大学医院 EEG 语料库（Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus）的记录，证实其与异质性临床数据兼容。在真实临床 EEG 的受试者层面增强实验中，用 NeuroSim 样本补充真实训练数据后，AD 与健康对照的分类准确率从 91.6% 提高到 94.5%，PD 与健康对照的分类准确率从 90.9% 提高到 94.0%，超过了传统信号层面增强所获得的提升。NeuroSim 以开源软件形式发布，以支持神经系统疾病诊断中的数据增强、基准测试和可解释人工智能。

title: Learning RNA secondary structure from chemical probing with MXfold2
zh_title: MXfold2利用化学探测学习RNA二级结构
summary: 扩展MXfold2，使其从化学探测数据学习，仅凭序列预测RNA二级结构，提出三种训练目标，并在模拟及外部结构测试中显示改进。
key_points: 引入三种利用探测谱的训练目标
结合隐式最大似然估计穿透离散折叠
结合结构预训练与回放后碱基对预测提升
reason: 有新方法与外部测试，但属RNA基础研究预印本，医疗关联弱
abstract: Training RNA secondary structure predictors is limited by scarce reference annotations, even as chemical probing produces abundant nucleotide-level measurements. These measurements inform pairing states without identifying base-pairing partners. Here we extend MXfold2, which combines neural and thermodynamic folding scores, to learn from probing profiles and predict RNA secondary structures from sequence alone. We introduce three training objectives. One learns from probing-assisted target structures. The other two use implicit maximum-likelihood estimation to pass surrogate gradients from reactivity-ranking and likelihood losses through discrete folding. Simulations, RNAgym measurements and external structural tests show improved chemical agreement and gains in exact base-pair prediction when chemical supervision is combined with structural pretraining and replay. Probing profiles can thus broaden the range of RNAs that inform sequence-only structure prediction, including RNA populations with few complete structure annotations.

title: A Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble Framework for Privacy-Preserving Mortality Prediction Across Heterogeneous Healthcare Systems
zh_title: 区块链联邦集成框架：跨异构医疗系统的隐私保护死亡率预测
summary: 提出区块链联邦集成框架，仅在同行医院验证后才接纳模型，通过模拟研究检验其排除被投毒或替换模型的能力。
key_points: 智能合约按同行AUROC中位数≥0.70准入模型
采用加权logit平均或堆叠并联邦重校准
基于单一中心模拟四家医院的回顾性模拟
reason: 预印本，仅模拟、无真实多中心验证，增量档
abstract: Objective: To test whether a smart contract that admits hospital-trained models to a shared mortality model only after peer hospitals verify their performance can exclude poisoned or substituted models, and at what cost. Design: Retrospective simulation study of a federated learning protocol. Methodology: In the Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble (BFE), hospitals committed SHA-256 digests of locally trained XGBoost and random-forest models to a Solidity contract; peers posted digest-bound validation AUROCs, and the contract admitted models with a median peer AUROC of at least 0.70. Admitted models were pooled by weighted logit averaging (BFE-PW) or stacking (BFE-Stack) with federated recalibration. Code and drafts were produced with an AI coding assistant under the authors' supervision. Setting: Four hospitals simulated from one academic centre with age, renal case-mix and laboratory-availability skew; a data-scarce regime keeping 5-20% of each hospital's patients; and a natural partition by care era. Participants: 425,215 adult admissions (186,103 patients; 2.35% in-hospital mortality) in MIMIC-IV v3.1, with predictors from the first 24 hours. Interventions: BFE against centralised, local-only, FedAvg, FedProx, median and Multi-Krum FedAvg and federated logistic regression, under seven attacks on training, attestation, recalibration and model delivery. Main outcome measures: AUROC and AUPRC (joint patient-clustered bootstrap), calibration, attack effects, gas and transactions. Results: Under gross label flipping, FedAvg lost 29% of its AUPRC while the contract excluded the poisoned models in every seed (Multi-Krum FedAvg was equally protected); all substituted models were detected, and collusion blocked release. A targeted flip of female deaths passed the gate and lowered sensitivity for deaths in women from 32.8% to 27.5%; poisoned recalibration inverted BFE-PW (AUROC 0.098) unless a median-of-sites recalibration was used (0.902). With large hospitals, BFE-PW matched FedAvg in AUROC (0.902) and BFE-Stack matched FedProx (0.907 and 0.906), below local-only (0.910) and centralised XGBoost (0.915), with lower AUPRC; with 5% of the data, BFE-PW exceeded local models (0.866 against 0.844). Pooled calibration hid two-fold under-prediction at one hospital (observed-to-expected ratio 2.13), which a local intercept corrected (0.93). One aggregation used 37 transactions and 3.3 million gas, rising roughly quadratically with consortium size. Conclusions: Contrac
zh_abstract: 【目的】检验这样一种智能合约能否排除被投毒或被替换的模型及其代价：该合约只有在同行医院验证了医院自训练模型的性能之后，才允许该模型进入共享死亡率模型。【设计】联邦学习协议的回顾性模拟研究。【方法】在区块链赋能联邦集成（Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble，BFE）中，各医院将本地训练的 XGBoost 和随机森林模型的 SHA-256 摘要提交至 Solidity 合约；同行医院发布与摘要绑定的验证 AUROC，合约接纳同行 AUROC 中位数不低于 0.70 的模型。被接纳的模型通过加权 logit 平均（BFE-PW）或堆叠（BFE-Stack）进行汇集，并进行联邦重校准。代码和初稿由 AI 编程助手在作者监督下生成。【设置】由一个学术中心模拟出的四家医院，具有年龄、肾功能病例构成和实验室检查可得性方面的偏斜；一种数据稀缺情形，即每家医院仅保留 5%–20% 的患者；以及按诊疗时代划分的自然分区。【参与者】MIMIC-IV v3.1 中的 425,215 例成人入院记录（186,103 名患者；院内死亡率 2.35%），预测变量取自最初 24 小时。【干预】将 BFE 与集中式、仅本地、FedAvg、FedProx、中位数及 Multi-Krum FedAvg 和联邦逻辑回归进行比较，并施加针对训练、证明（attestation）、重校准和模型交付的七种攻击。【主要结局指标】AUROC 和 AUPRC（联合的按患者聚类 bootstrap）、校准度、攻击效应、gas 和交易数。【结果】在严重标签翻转下，FedAvg 的 AUPRC 下降 29%，而合约在每个随机种子中均排除了被投毒的模型（Multi-Krum FedAvg 同样受到保护）；所有被替换的模型均被检出，合谋阻止了模型发布。针对女性死亡病例的定向翻转通过了准入关卡，使女性死亡患者的灵敏度从 32.8% 降至 27.5%；被投毒的重校准使 BFE-PW 发生反转（AUROC 0.098），除非采用各站点中位数重校准（0.902）。在大型医院情形下，BFE-PW 的 AUROC 与 FedAvg 相当（0.902），BFE-Stack 与 FedProx 相当（0.907 和 0.906），低于仅本地（0.910）和集中式 XGBoost（0.915），且 AUPRC 较低；在仅有 5% 数据时，BFE-PW 优于本地模型（0.866 对 0.844）。汇总校准掩盖了某一家医院两倍的预测不足（观察与预期比值 2.13），而本地截距校正后得以纠正（0.93）。一次聚合使用 37 笔交易和 330 万 gas，并大致随联盟规模呈二次方增长。【结论】Contrac（原文在此截断）

title: Building an Auditable Reference Standard for Clinical Information Extraction from Transesophageal Echocardiography Reports
zh_title: 经食管超声心动图报告信息抽取的可审计参考标准构建
summary: 在两家机构各取 150 份术中 TEE 报告，由四名标注员按 39 变量编码本标注，并分析分歧以评估临床信息模型的局限（预印本）。
key_points: 共 300 份报告，来自宾大与华盛顿大学
四名标注员使用 39 变量 V1 编码本
结构化裁决分歧，检验信息模型局限
reason: 样本仅 300 份，为参考标准构建，预印本，属增量档
abstract: Objectives To develop an auditable, two-institution reference standard for intraoperative transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) reports and evaluate whether reviewer disagreement identifies limitations in the underlying clinical information model. Materials and Methods We selected 300 reports (150 per institution) from 925 at the University of Pennsylvania and University of Washington using random sampling and enrichment for challenging documentation. Four trained abstractors applied a shared 39-variable V1 codebook. Independent paired comparisons included 297 reports; three historical reports contributed only to the final reference standard. Categorical agreement used exact agreement and unweighted Cohen's {kappa}; numeric left-ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) used exact agreement and mean absolute differences. Disagreements underwent structured expert adjudication and reason classification. Additional analyses assessed reviewer-pair, sampling-stratified, and population-weighted agreement. Results Among 11,583 formal reviewer-comparison cells, 10,293 (88.9%) were resolved by reviewer agreement and 1,290 (11.1%) required targeted expert adjudication (1,289 tasks). Codebook/schema ambiguity (40.8%) and interpretation/classification differences (25.2%) together accounted for 66.0% of targeted tasks. Adjudication was concentrated in aortic dissection, valve type, and post-intervention findings. Categorical {kappa} ranged from 0.364 to 0.960 and was inversely correlated with targeted-adjudication burden (Spearman {rho}=-0.884; 95% CI, -0.955 to -0.734). Sampling-weighted {kappa} changed by no more than 0.05 for 32 of 35 categorical variables. Discussion Structured adjudication identified recurring schema and interpretation challenges beyond individual abstraction errors, providing specific targets for information-model refinement. Conclusion As NLP and LLM-based abstraction tools move toward clinical use, the reference standards used to evaluate them require comparably rigorous development, adjudication, and independent validation.
zh_abstract: 【目的】建立一个可审计的、涉及两家机构的术中经食管超声心动图（TEE）报告参考标准，并评估评审者之间的分歧是否能够揭示底层临床信息模型的局限。【材料与方法】我们采用随机抽样并富集文档记录具有挑战性的报告，从宾夕法尼亚大学和华盛顿大学的 925 份报告中选取 300 份（每家机构 150 份）。四名经过培训的摘录员应用共同的 39 变量 V1 编码手册。独立配对比较纳入 297 份报告；另有三份历史报告仅用于最终参考标准。分类变量一致性采用精确一致率和未加权 Cohen's κ；数值型左心室射血分数（LVEF）采用精确一致率和平均绝对差。分歧经过结构化专家裁定和原因分类。另行分析了评审者配对、按抽样分层以及按人群加权的一致性。【结果】在 11,583 个正式的评审者比较单元中，10,293 个（88.9%）通过评审者一致得到解决，1,290 个（11.1%）需要针对性的专家裁定（1,289 项任务）。编码手册/模式歧义（40.8%）和解释/分类差异（25.2%）合计占针对性任务的 66.0%。裁定集中于主动脉夹层、瓣膜类型和干预后表现。分类变量 κ 范围为 0.364 至 0.960，与针对性裁定负担呈负相关（Spearman ρ=-0.884；95% CI，-0.955 至 -0.734）。35 个分类变量中有 32 个的抽样加权 κ 变化不超过 0.05。【讨论】结构化裁定识别出超出个别摘录错误之外的反复出现的模式和解释方面的挑战，为信息模型的改进提供了具体目标。【结论】随着基于自然语言处理（NLP）和大语言模型（LLM）的摘录工具走向临床应用，用于评估它们的参考标准也需要同等严谨地开发、裁定和独立验证。

title: Patient-Expressed Needs, Burdens and Barriers in Taiwanese Online Health Discussions: A Taiwan-Contextualized Friction Framework Applied With Large Language Model-Based Social Listening
zh_title: 基于大模型的台湾在线健康讨论患者需求与障碍社会倾听
summary: 利用LLM对台湾PTT论坛及问诊平台的繁体中文讨论做社会倾听，构建八领域“摩擦”框架刻画患者需求、负担与障碍。
key_points: 数据源为1360万条文本存档
抽样9131条流水线标记及1000条未标记帖
提出台湾情境化八领域框架

Regulatory guidance on patient-focused drug development recognizes social-media listening as a source of patient experience data, but no systematic framework exists for Traditional Chinese discussions in Taiwan, and keyword pipelines measure such content poorly. Objective: To characterize patient-expressed needs, burdens and barriers ("frictions") in Taiwanese online health discussions with an eight-domain, Taiwan-contextualized framework, identify whose frictions they are, and assess how securely each is measured. zh_abstract:
【背景】患者在疾病与诊疗过程中遇到的困难（看不懂检查结果、痛苦情绪、日常活动受限、不知该去哪里就诊、家庭压力）可能不会出现在临床接诊或病历记录中。以患者为中心的药物研发监管指南承认社交媒体监听是患者体验数据的一个来源，但针对台湾繁体中文讨论尚无系统性框架，而关键词流程对此类内容的测量效果较差。
【目的】采用一个八领域、结合台湾情境的框架，刻画台湾网络健康讨论中患者表达的需求、负担和障碍（“摩擦”，frictions），识别这些摩擦是谁的，并评估每一项的测量可靠程度。

abstract: Introduction: What people with kidney concerns or disease and their families struggle with between visits may not surface in clinic. We mapped the needs and burdens they express online by clinical context and author. Methods: A large language model read all 22,170 posts reached by a chronic kidney disease tag or kidney lexicon on a Taiwanese forum and 3 ask-a-physician services (1995-2026), applying a companion friction framework with kidney-specific fields, author (patient or family) and clinical context. A second vendor re-read 11,010 posts; 2 physicians labelled relevance, author and context in 200. Results: Among 6,023 kidney-related posts, the reproducibly measured fields most often voiced on the forum were information needs (79%), emotional burden (48%), system navigation (34%) and worry about progression (24%). After abnormal tests, 54%-56% of posts quoted a laboratory value, nearly always with a question or stated uncertainty; renal-diet burden peaked with diagnosed disease; caregiver burden rose to 29% of dialysis-or-transplantation forum posts. Family-written posts more often voiced navigation difficulty and caregiver burden. Most fields agreed with the second vendor (kappa 0.65-0.98). On the model's labels, family members wrote 25% of forum posts about kidney concerns and 74% about dialysis or transplantation; on a 139-post sample, physicians' labels gave 47%-48% for dialysis or transplantation (model 71%). Conclusion: Kidney-related posts carry context-specific information needs and emotional and practical burdens, many voiced by relatives. They suggest candidate responses (test-result explanation, diet support, family-directed information and support) that need evaluation. Keywords: chronic kidney disease; dialysis; patient experience; caregivers; social media; large language models

abstract: Objective: To describe how intensive care unit (ICU) time is composed after stroke, and to test whether simulating patient condition, transfer readiness and ICU exit separately predicts as accurately as direct models. Materials and Methods: In 6,366 ICU stays for stroke in MIMIC IV, hourly readiness criteria divided ICU hours into organ support needs, stroke specific needs, and time not explained by these needs. An hourly simulator was built on stays up to 2016, frozen, and validated on 2017 to 2019 (n=1,714) and 2020 onwards (n=1,521). The primary measure was the 24 hour alive exit Brier score versus the strongest direct model (gradient boosting). Results: Unexplained time was 34.1% of hours in standard ICUs and 87.6% in neuro intermediate units. 37.8% of stays lost readiness for [≥]6 consecutive hours after first confirmation. The simulator and gradient boosting were indistinguishable (Brier 0.1238 vs 0.1245; difference -0.0007, 95% CI -0.0030 to 0.0016). The simulator was better calibrated at 48 and 72 hours but discriminated less well (C statistic 0.71 vs 0.74 to 0.75). All models overpredicted exit after 2016; the error lay mainly after readiness (median 40 hours simulated vs 68 observed). Discussion: Readiness was not a single event: patients often lost and regained it, and many stayed long after meeting it, especially in neuro intermediate units, which exist for monitoring. Separate modelling did not improve accuracy but placed the post 2016 error after readiness, as the unit mix changed. Conclusion: The simulator matched the strongest direct model while also generating complete trajectories. It needs external validation before any clinical use.

abstract: Objective: To describe and evaluate a framework for using a large language model (LLM) as the primary coder in health content analysis, and to propose reporting items for LLM assisted studies, because no reporting standard exists. Methods: An LLM coded 6,982 Instagram and TikTok posts using a human written, human calibrated instrument. The framework has six components: human authorship of the instrument; two round human calibration; source discipline; quote anchored coding; verification in a representative and an outcome enriched sample, blinded in both directions; and per variable reliability reporting against a prespecified threshold, with the consequence of failure fixed in advance. Agreement was measured with Gwets AC1, prespecified because the outcome distribution was heavily skewed. Results: Agreement between the two human coders on the primary outcome rose from AC1 0.456 to 0.977 after two ambiguous rules were rewritten. LLM human agreement was 0.847 in the representative sample (N = 150) and 0.868 in the enriched sample (N = 50). Five of eight conditional variables fell below the 0.80 threshold and became exploratory: variables asking whether a defined textual feature was present met it, whereas those requiring graded judgement did not. The human coder identified misinformation more often than the LLM, so prevalence estimates are likely underestimates. Agreement on female targeting was lower for self-identified ethnic minority creators (0.744 versus 0.902). Conclusion: LLM coding cannot be computationally reproduced, so its reliability must be shown empirically: per variable agreement with independent human coding, the direction of remaining error, and a prespecified response to shortfall. The authors propose 18 reporting items for LLM assisted content analysis.

abstract: [Open forum infectious diseases] Fellowship program directors (PDs) oversee a broad range of responsibilities spanning recruitment, education, mentorship, evaluation, scheduling, accreditation, and program administration. These activities require substantial time and coordination, often with limited resources. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers an opportunity to support PD workflows. In this review, we describe practical applications of AI in fellowship leadership using real-world examples from an Infectious Diseases fellowship program. Applications include recruitment marketing, applicant review and summarization, multilingual global health education, individualized board preparation, and scheduling optimization. We also discuss governance considerations and lessons from other industries that have successfully integrated AI into complex workflows. Artificial intelligence can expand the PD toolkit and support more efficient program management, potentially allowing greater focus on mentorship, education, and program development. Further evaluation is needed to assess its effects on efficiency, cost, educational outcomes, and recruitment.

abstract: Monitoring physiological parameters such as respiratory rate ($f_R$) is essential for diagnosing and managing various pathological conditions. Thermal imaging offers a promising contactless alternative to traditional methods, which often rely on partially invasive sensors or obtrusive wearable systems. However, existing approaches for $f_R$ estimation from thermal signals typically require extensive pre-processing and manual or semi-automatic region-of-interest (ROI) tracking, limiting their practical applicability. This study proposes a deep learning-based method for estimating $f_R$ directly from thermal videos, eliminating the need for complex pre-processing and ROI tracking. A 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) is developed to operate on raw thermal video data. To address challenges related to small datasets, the model is trained using data augmentation and transfer learning from synthetic datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves a validation $R^2$ score of approximately 0.61 on both pre-processed and raw thermal videos. By simplifying the workflow, this method holds promise for enhancing the feasibility of thermal imaging in real-world applications, such as remote healthcare and driver monitoring in automotive applications.

abstract: [Frontiers in chemistry] Sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) regulates the bioavailability of circulating androgens and estrogens through high-affinity binding. Chemicals that bind SHBG may alter the equilibrium between bound and free hormone fractions, making SHBG binding activity a relevant endpoint for endocrine disruption assessment. However, experimental assessment of SHBG binding is resource intensive with low throughput, limiting its application to large chemical inventories. To enable large-scale screening, we developed machine learning, deep learning, and consensus models using a dataset of 125 chemicals tested in a human SHBG competitive binding assay. Random forest, support vector machine, and multilayer perceptron models were trained using molecular descriptors, while a graph isomorphism network with edge features was trained using molecular graph representations. A consensus model was then generated by averaging the predicted probabilities from the four individual models. Model performance was evaluated using 100 iterations of 5-fold cross-validation and external validation with an independent dataset curated from ChEMBL. All models showed good predictive performance, with accuracy ranging from 0.811 to 0.855 in internal validation and from 0.793-0.890 in external validation. The consensus model had the best overall performance, yielding accuracy of 0.855 and 0.884 in internal and external validations, respectively. Confidence analysis further showed that prediction accuracy increased with prediction confidence, indicating the practical utility of confidence estimates for decision-making. These results indicate that consensus modeling can reliably predict SHBG-binding activity and provide a rapid, cost-effective approach for screening large chemical inventories. The proposed models can support the prioritization of chemicals for experimental testing, facilitate the identification of potential endocrine-disrupting substances, and complement New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) used in chemical safety assessment.

abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] The fragment ion indexed database searching approach enables highly efficient tandem mass spectrometry database searches, including real-time search workflows. However, the index can require tens of gigabytes of memory, often exceeding the free memory available on instrument acquisition computers running the search. This restricts the size of the searchable database, the variable modification space, and the number of searches that can run concurrently. To address this problem, we developed an index-pruning pipeline within the Comet database search tool using Carafe, a deep learning tool that predicts fragment ion intensities based on peptide sequences. In our approach, only fragment ion positions that are predicted to be observable are written in the index, eliminating entries that are unlikely to contribute to spectrum detection. We evaluated this approach on two search spaces in three index configurations to demonstrate that masking significantly reduced the number of fragment ion index entries and, consequently, peak search memory use. Masked searches were also faster than unmasked searches and identified a comparable number of peptide-spectrum matches. Because all prediction and masking steps are performed before searching, their cost is amortized across repeated, future searches of the same database and modification configuration, introducing no per-spectrum search overhead. The complete implementation is open source with an Apache license.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv：生物学预印本服务器] 碎片离子索引数据库搜索方法可实现高效的串联质谱数据库搜索，包括实时搜索工作流程。然而，该索引可能需要数十GB的内存，常常超过运行搜索的仪器采集计算机上的可用内存。这限制了可搜索数据库的大小、可变修饰空间以及可同时运行的搜索数量。为解决这一问题，我们在Comet数据库搜索工具中利用Carafe（一种基于肽段序列预测碎片离子强度的深度学习工具）开发了索引剪枝流程。在我们的方法中，仅将预测可被观测到的碎片离子位置写入索引，从而剔除了不太可能有助于谱图检测的条目。我们在两个搜索空间、三种索引配置下评估了该方法，结果表明掩蔽显著减少了碎片离子索引条目的数量，从而降低了搜索峰值内存使用。掩蔽搜索也比未掩蔽搜索更快，并且鉴定到的肽段-谱图匹配数量相当。由于所有预测和掩蔽步骤均在搜索之前完成，其成本可分摊到对同一数据库和修饰配置的重复、后续搜索中，不会引入每张谱图的搜索额外开销。完整实现以Apache许可证开源。
